LLM ensemble PREVIA predicts future PTSD risk from emergency department trauma narratives with expert-level accuracy
summary_zh: 研究引入PREVIA模型，通过分析急诊科创伤叙事预测创伤后应激障碍风险。模型从患者创伤叙事中提取早期创伤症状、创伤相关症状、风险和保护因素。
summary_en: This study introduces the PREVIA model, which predicts future PTSD risk from emergency department trauma narratives with expert-level accuracy. The model extracts early post-traumatic stress symptoms, peri-traumatic symptoms, risk, and protective factors from unstructured patient trauma narratives.
insights: 创新点：PREVIA模型预测PTSD风险
方法亮点：分析创伤叙事
关键发现：早期症状识别
insights_en: Novelty: PREVIA model predicts PTSD risk
Method highlight: Analysis of trauma narratives
Key finding: Identification of early symptoms
abstract: Post-traumatic stress disorder affects numerous trauma survivors following emergency department discharge, making this encounter vital for early risk stratification. Yet emergency clinicians face severe time constraints, making existing screening tools impractical. We introduce PREVIA, a clinically-informed large language model ensemble, that predicts post-traumatic stress disorder risk from unstructured patient trauma narratives, collected in response to a routine-care question asked in the emergency department, by extracting early post-traumatic stress symptoms, peri-traumatic symptoms, risk, and protective factors. Within an ongoing longitudinal study, we included N = 145 patients across two New York City level-1 trauma centers within 24 hours of trauma and assessed post-traumatic stress disorder 1-month post-trauma. In this work, PREVIA accurately forecasts post-traumatic stress disorder (AUROC = 78.49% ± 5.75%, sensitivity=95.4% ± 3.99%, precision=46.76% ± 8.66%), performs comparably to an emergency clinician specialized in post-traumatic stress disorder on 30 randomly selected patients (PREVIA: AUROC = 84.39%, sensitivity=100.00%, precision=50.00%; clinician: AUROC = 83.86%, sensitivity=88.89%, precision=50.00%), and generates interpretable explanations without additional clinical burden. These initial findings support PREVIA’s potential as a scalable emergency department screener for timely, targeted interventions, and warrant validation in larger, independent cohorts. PTSD screening is rarely feasible in busy emergency departments. Here, the authors show that a scalable AI ensemble can predict 1-month PTSD risk from a single routine-care question, a first step toward low-burden implementation at point of care.

title: Electrode-associated growth reveals structure of OmcZ-type cytochrome nanowires in anaerobic methanotrophic archaea
summary_zh: 研究通过电极培养揭示厌氧产甲烷古菌中OmcZ型细胞色素纳米线的结构。培养在电极上获得近无污染培养物，揭示了其生理特性和结构。
summary_en: This study reveals the structure of OmcZ-type cytochrome nanowires in anaerobic methanotrophic archaea through electrode cultivation. Near-axenic cultures are obtained on electrodes, revealing their physiological properties and structure.
insights: 创新点：电极培养揭示纳米线结构
方法亮点：近无污染培养物获得
关键发现：生理特性和结构
insights_en: Novelty: Electrode cultivation reveals nanowire structure
Method highlight: Acquisition of near-axenic cultures
Key finding: Physiological properties and structure
abstract: Abstract Anaerobic methanotrophic (ANME) archaea are key regulators of methane emissions in anoxic environments, yet their physiology remains poorly understood due to the lack of axenic cultures. Here, we show that cultivation on poised electrodes yields near-axenic cultures (95.8% relative abundance) of a freshwater ANME, for which we propose the name ‘ Candidatus Methanoperedens vercellensis’. We identified key physiological properties of ‘ Ca . M. vercellensis’: doubling times of 4.6 days at 30 °C, menaquinone as respiratory electron carrier, the inability to oxidize ethane, and preferential reduction of iron oxides over nitrate after cultivation on electrodes. A 3.3 Å cryo-electron microscopy structure of filaments displayed on the archaeal surface revealed polymerized OmcZ-type cytochrome nanowires, which are homologous to OmcZ nanowires essential for long-range (>10 μm) extracellular electron transfer (EET) in Geobacter sulfurreducens . The archaeal OmcZ-type nanowires include dense, collinear stacking of protected hemesakin to bacterial OmcZ nanowires, but with post-translational modification, thus yielding morphology distinct from bacterial OmcZ nanowires. Notably, in contrast to bacterial OmcZ, archaeal OmcZ-type nanowires do not form interconnected networks, and hemes are less solvent-exposed, which can protect them from the environment. Surprisingly, these archaea assemble OmcZ into nanowires even in the apparent absence of prolyl isomerase involved in folding bacterial OmcZ. This work establishes a model system for molecular understanding of nanowire-mediated EET in archaea.

title: Absolute quantification and profiling of cellular tRNAs by nanopore sequencing and a deep learning classifier
summary_zh: 本文开发纳米孔测序与深度学习模型，用于细胞tRNA的绝对定量与鉴定。模型直接利用纳米孔信号，准确率达98.2%。实验验证了模型在tRNA鉴定中的有效性。
summary_en: This paper develops a nanopore sequencing and deep learning model for absolute quantification and profiling of cellular tRNAs. The model directly utilizes nanopore signals with 98.2% accuracy, validated by experiments for its effectiveness in tRNA identification.
insights: 创新点：直接利用纳米孔信号进行tRNA鉴定
方法亮点：深度学习模型提高tRNA鉴定准确率
关键发现：模型在多种tRNA物种中表现优异
insights_en: Novelty: Direct identification of tRNAs using nanopore signals
Method highlight: Deep learning model enhances tRNA identification accuracy
Key finding: Model excels in various tRNA species
abstract: Transfer RNAs (tRNAs) link mRNA codons to amino acids during translation. Their abundance and modification states are dynamically regulated and influence translation efficiency, mRNA stability, and proteostasis. Accurate profiling of tRNAs is essential, but deep sequencing suffers from modification-induced biases during cDNA synthesis, while nanopore direct RNA sequencing (DRS) still faces challenges in accurate tRNA profiling. Here, we develop an end-to-end deep learning model, termed nano tRNA classifier, that directly uses nanopore-DRS ionic current signals to classify tRNAs without basecalling. The model achieves 98.2% classification accuracy with high read retention across all Escherichia coli tRNA species. Using an equimolar mixture of native tRNAs as a ground-truth reference, we correct read-count bias, enabling absolute quantification and profiling under diverse culture conditions. We further develop binary classifiers that detect specific tRNA modifications at the single-molecule level with high accuracy. This nanopore-based platform integrates accurate tRNA classification, absolute quantification, and single-molecule modification detection. Here the authors develop a nanopore-based method using deep learning to classify cellular tRNAs, quantify their absolute abundance, and detect chemical modifications at the single molecule level.

title: Hydration water drives elastin’s entropic elasticity
summary_zh: 本文通过模拟研究，发现水分子的熵变是弹性蛋白弹性的主要驱动力。拉伸过程中，水分子的重新排列导致熵变降低，从而影响弹性。
summary_en: This study finds through simulations that the entropy change of hydration water is the main driving force for elastin's entropic elasticity. During stretching, the rearrangement of water molecules leads to a decrease in entropy, affecting elasticity.
insights: 创新点：揭示水分子的熵变在弹性蛋白中的作用
方法亮点：多微秒全原子模拟研究
关键发现：水分子的重新排列影响弹性
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the role of hydration water's entropy in elastin
Method highlight: Multi-microsecond all-atom simulations
Key finding: Water rearrangement affects elasticity
abstract: Elastin endows arteries, skin and lungs with elasticity, yet the molecular origin of its entropic recoil remains debated. Using multi-microsecond all-atom simulations of a representative elastomeric region of human tropoelastin, the monomeric precursor of elastin, we quantify protein conformational entropy, hydration-water entropy, and protein- and water-mediated interaction enthalpies during stretching. Protein conformational entropy decreases modestly overall, with heterogeneous local entropic responses governed by secondary structure and sequence context. In contrast, hydration water provides the dominant unfavorable entropic contribution because stretching recruits many water molecules from bulk into a persistently low-entropy first hydration layer. Stretching also disrupts favorable intra-protein interactions while strengthening protein–water interactions, producing opposing enthalpic contributions that largely compensate the entropic penalty. Together, these results support a hydration-coupled thermodynamic mechanism in which water is the dominant entropic contributor to elastin recoil within a strongly compensating enthalpy–entropy balance. Elastin endows biological tissues with their remarkable elasticity, yet the molecular basis of its recoil has long remained unresolved. By simulating a representative elastomeric region of monomeric tropoelastin, and quantifying both protein conformational entropy and hydrationwater entropy, the authors provide an atomistic comparison of their respective contributions to elasticity. Their analysis reveals that hydration water is the dominant entropic driver of elastin recoil, acting within a finely balanced thermodynamic framework that governs stretch-induced molecular responses.

title: Correlative nanoscale chemical imaging reveals delocalized Faradaic processes at isolated MXene flakes
summary_zh: 本文利用扫描X射线显微镜和扫描电化学显微镜，揭示了MXene薄片上的电化学反应。研究发现，MXene薄片具有独特的电化学活性。
summary_en: This paper uses scanning X-ray microscopy and scanning electrochemical microscopy to reveal electrochemical reactions on MXene flakes. The study finds that MXene flakes have unique electrochemical activity.
insights: 创新点：纳米尺度化学成像揭示MXene薄片上的电化学反应
方法亮点：结合SXM和SECCM技术
关键发现：MXene薄片具有独特的电化学活性
insights_en: Novelty: Nanoscale chemical imaging reveals electrochemical reactions on MXene flakes
Method highlight: Combination of SXM and SECCM techniques
Key finding: MXene flakes exhibit unique electrochemical activity
abstract: Abstract Two-dimensional transition metal carbides and nitrides (MXenes) combine an electrochemically active surface with high conductivity and hydrophilicity, which makes them a unique class of materials for electrochemical applications. While the pseudocapacitive behaviour of MXenes in acidic environments is relatively well understood on macroscale electrodes, intrinsic electrochemical phenomena occurring on single MXene flakes remain unclear. Here, we use scanning X-ray microscopy (SXM) to correlate the electronic structure of Ti 3 C 2 T x MXene flakes at the nanoscale with local electrochemical reactions triggered at the sub-flake level by scanning electrochemical cell microscopy (SECCM). For several proton-coupled electron transfer reactions, including electrochemical oxidation and the hydrogen evolution reaction, we demonstrate a delocalization of the reactions well beyond the MXene flake area in contact with the droplet cell. Furthermore, we show evidence of hydrogen storage on monolayer MXene flakes. This work highlights fundamental insights into the role of interfacial water on surface redox reactions.

title: Nanometer-resolution imaging of living bacteria across species and cellular orientations
summary_zh: 本文通过改进的AFM技术，实现了对活细菌的纳米级成像。研究揭示了LPS复杂性与AFM对比度之间的关系。
summary_en: This paper achieves nanometer-resolution imaging of living bacteria using an improved AFM technique. The study reveals the relationship between LPS complexity and AFM contrast.
insights: 创新点：改进AFM技术实现活细菌纳米级成像
方法亮点：实现种间和细胞取向的稳健粘附
关键发现：LPS复杂性与AFM对比度相关
insights_en: Novelty: Improved AFM technique for nanometer-resolution imaging of living bacteria
Method highlight: Robust adhesion across species and cellular orientations
Key finding: LPS complexity is related to AFM contrast
abstract: Abstract The bacterial cell envelope is a complex superstructure that is an important target and a major barrier for antibiotics. To date, highest-resolution images of native cell envelopes have been obtained by atomic force microscopy (AFM), but its use is limited by challenges in bacterial immobilization. We establish glutaraldehyde-functionalized glass surfaces for reversible covalent attachment, enabling robust adhesion across species and cellular orientations while preserving cell viability and growth. This approach allowed imaging of Escherichia coli both expressing O-antigen and fully lacking lipopolysaccharide (LPS) oligosaccharides, revealing that AFM contrast depends on LPS complexity and confirming previously observed outer membrane domains as LPS-enriched islands. It also enabled imaging of Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Acinetobacter baumannii outer membranes, which lack the characteristic protein trimers observed in model E. coli . Finally, we discovered growth-phase dependent alterations in E. coli pole morphology, where trimer networks typical of exponential-phase cells were unresolved and morphological defects appeared.

title: Archival and palaeoenvironmental documentation of extreme climate events reveals generational amnesia in collective memory
summary_zh: 本文利用气候档案和树轮重建，发现集体记忆中存在代际遗忘现象。历史记录显示，对极端气候事件的严重性评估往往偏向于近期经验。
summary_en: This paper, using climatic archives and tree-ring reconstructions, finds a phenomenon of generational amnesia in collective memory. Historical records show that severity assessments of extreme climate events often bias toward recent experiences.
insights: 创新点：利用气候档案揭示集体记忆中的代际遗忘
方法亮点：结合气候档案和树轮重建
关键发现：历史记录显示评估偏向近期经验
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing generational amnesia in collective memory using climatic archives
Method highlight: Combination of climatic archives and tree-ring reconstructions
Key finding: Historical records show bias toward recent experiences in assessments
abstract: Abstract Collective memory shapes how societies respond to extreme climate events, yet long-term evidence on how the collective memory of such events becomes perceptually biased over time is lacking. Here, we utilise four centuries (1470–1900) of climatic archives from northern China, along with tree–ring–based hydroclimate reconstructions, which are validated against instrumental observations of Wet/Dry Index (1901–2000) to fill the gap. We find that historical records reveal systematic, non-random mismatches, where severity assessments are often biased toward recent experience rather than absolute climatic anomalies. Correlations between historical and natural records increase when the natural series is re-standardised using 20–40-year sliding windows, reflecting a generational offset. A heuristic agent-based model reproduces this pattern, suggesting that generational amnesia is sufficient to explain the offsets in perception of environmental change. We argue that historical archives carry a generational imprint of perceptual bias, in which the severity of climate extremes is judged against recent lived experience rather than long-term climate variability. This has implications for bias-aware corrections for risk assessment, adaptation, and paleoclimate reconstruction.

title: Repeated loss of the West Antarctic Ice Sheet’s Amundsen Sea sector during late Pleistocene interglacials
summary_zh: 本文通过研究南极大陆边缘沉积物，发现西南极冰盖在晚更新世间冰期经历了多次大规模融化。
summary_en: This paper, through the study of West Antarctic continental margin sediments, finds that the West Antarctic Ice Sheet experienced repeated major melting during the late Pleistocene interglacials.
insights: 创新点：研究南极大陆边缘沉积物揭示冰盖融化
方法亮点：分析粘土矿物组合和过去海洋温度
关键发现：冰盖融化导致海平面上升
insights_en: Novelty: Studying sedimentary records to reveal ice sheet melting
Method highlight: Analysis of clay mineral assemblages and past ocean temperatures
Key finding: Ice sheet melting led to sea level rise
abstract: Abstract Sea-level reconstructions and numerical models suggest that the vulnerable West Antarctic Ice Sheet underwent major mass losses during the late Pleistocene, raising global sea level by several metres. However, direct evidence from ice-sheet proximal records for such retreat has remained inconclusive. Here we investigate variations in clay mineral assemblages and past ocean temperatures archived in West Antarctic continental margin sediments during the last 800,000 years. Our results demonstrate that the supply of glacigenic detritus sourced from the main outlet glaciers in the Amundsen Sea sector of the West Antarctic Ice Sheet ceased almost entirely during all previous warm periods, documenting the loss of their drainage basins. Concomitant seawater warming, revealed by a microfossil proxy, is attributed to intensified deep-water advection towards Antarctica’s Pacific margin, which is corroborated by the clay mineralogical evidence. Our findings show that ocean forcing can drive major deglaciation of West Antarctica and related global sea-level rise.

title: Robust Reasoning Segmentation for Open-World MLLMs without Catastrophic Forgetting
summary_zh: 本文研究无灾难性遗忘的开放世界MLLM推理分割。方法上，引入LENS，一种轻量级插件式方法，在不损害基础完整性情况下赋予MLLM像素级能力。实验表明，LENS在不影响模型通用能力的情况下提高了分割性能。
summary_en: This paper studies robust reasoning segmentation for Open-World MLLMs without catastrophic forgetting. The method introduces LENS, a lightweight plug-and-play paradigm that equips MLLMs with pixel-level ability without compromising their foundational integrity. Experiments show that LENS improves segmentation performance without affecting the model's general-purpose capabilities.
insights: 创新点：LENS方法无灾难性遗忘
方法亮点：轻量级插件式方法
关键发现：提高分割性能而不损害通用能力
insights_en: Novelty: LENS method without catastrophic forgetting
Method highlight: Lightweight plug-and-play paradigm
Key finding: Improved segmentation performance without compromising general-purpose capabilities
abstract: Abstract Ensuring trustworthiness and versatility in Open-World Visual Recognition is a core goal of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While integrating segmentation is desirable, prevailing methods require invasive fine-tuning, which often leads to catastrophic forgetting of the model’s general-purpose capabilities. This trade-off between task-specific performance and general reliability fundamentally undermines the goal of building unified, trustworthy systems. We introduce LENS ( L everaging k E ypoi N ts for MLLMs’ S egmentation), a novel plug-and-play paradigm designed to equip MLLMs with pixel-level ability without compromising their foundational integrity. LENS attaches a lightweight head to a completely frozen MLLM, interpreting the intrinsic spatial cues embedded in attention maps. It extracts keypoints and translates them into prompt-compatible features for a mask decoder. Extensive experiments validate that LENS achieves segmentation performance competitive with retraining-based methods. Crucially, it largely preserves the MLLM’s open-world generalization, avoiding the degradation observed in fine-tuned counterparts. By decoupling segmentation from generation, LENS offers a robust and efficient path toward truly multi-talented and reliable vision models.

summary_zh: 通过自突触灵感设计的神经形态硬件，实现局部双向反馈控制，应用于温度调节。
summary_en: An autapse-inspired neuromorphic hardware for localized bidirectional feedback control, applied in thermoregulation.
insights: 创新点：自突触灵感设计神经形态硬件
方法亮点：实现局部双向反馈控制
关键发现：应用于温度调节
insights_en: Novelty: Autapse-inspired neuromorphic hardware design
Method highlight: Achieving localized bidirectional feedback control
Key finding: Application in thermoregulation
abstract: Abstract Establishing autonomous and energy-efficient feedback control at the hardware level remains challenging because conventional systems rely on centralized processing and continuous external computation, increasing energy consumption and system complexity. Here we show a neuromorphic autapse-inspired system that enables localized and bidirectional feedback control, using thermoregulation as a representative application. An autapse is a self-synaptic connection in which a neuron feeds its output back to its own synaptic input, enabling intrinsic feedback modulation. The system integrates a solid electrolyte-based synaptic transistor capable of multiplexing multiple inputs and a bidirectional leaky integrate-and-fire artificial neuron. By feeding the neuronal output back to an additional synaptic gate, excitatory and inhibitory feedback loops are realized within a compact architecture. Using an artificial thermoregulation platform, temperature-dependent inputs bidirectionally modulate neuronal firing frequency, demonstrating biologically inspired feedback control with a compact set of neuromorphic devices for autonomous and energy-efficient systems.

Block-Wise Variable Conditional Diffusion for High-Fidelity Text-to-4D Generation

summary_en: This paper presents the Swin4D framework to address challenges in high-dimensional diffusion model training, semantic misalignment, and lack of high-quality datasets for text-to-4D scene generation. It introduces a block-wise variable conditional diffusion strategy to mitigate memory constraints and prevent overfitting, and proposes a global-local alignment mechanism for efficient and high-fidelity synthesis.
insights: 创新点：提出块状变量条件扩散策略
方法亮点：全局-局部对齐机制
关键发现：实现高效高保真文本到4D场景生成
insights_en: Novelty: Block-wise variable conditional diffusion strategy
Method highlight: Global-local alignment mechanism
Key finding: Efficient and high-fidelity text-to-4D scene generation
abstract: Abstract Text-to-4D scene generation is currently impeded by three primary challenges: the prohibitive memory cost of training high-dimensional diffusion models, the semantic misalignment arising from the failure to disentangle static object identity from dynamic motion in text conditioning, and the scarcity of high-quality datasets that accurately correlate subjects, motions, and environments. To surmount these challenges, we present Swin4D , an end-to-end framework for efficient and high-fidelity text-to-4D synthesis. First, we introduce a Block-wise Variable Conditional Diffusion strategy, which mitigates memory constraints and prevents overfitting by dynamically reconfiguring spatial dependencies during training. Second, we propose Global–Local Alignment , a hierarchical guidance mechanism that explicitly disentangles global scene context from local subject-action semantics via separate T5 and CLIP encoders, ensuring spatiotemporal consistency and fine-grained semantic fidelity regardless of prompt length. Finally, we address data limitations by curating RealSynth4D , a large-scale hybrid dataset combining 108k real-world captures with 72k AI-synthesised scenes, establishing robust correlations between subjects, actions, and complex backgrounds to significantly enhance model generalisation.

Spatial-Frequency-Aware Implicit Neural Representation of Multidimensional Signals via MLP-KAN Fusion
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于MLP-KAN融合的空间频率感知隐式神经网络表示方法。
summary_en: This paper proposes a spatial-frequency-aware implicit neural representation method for multidimensional signals via MLP-KAN fusion.
insights: 创新点：提出MLP-KAN融合方法
方法亮点：解决光谱偏差问题
关键发现：提高高频细节重建
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing the MLP-KAN fusion method
Method highlight: Resolving spectral bias issues
Key finding: Improving reconstruction of high-frequency details
abstract: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have emerged as a compelling paradigm for modeling multidimensional signals by mapping continuous coordinates to signal values. However, Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLP)-based INRs inherently suffer from spectral bias, which favors low-frequency components and suppresses the reconstruction of essential high-frequency details. While existing techniques, such as Fourier feature mappings, mitigate this issue, they often rely on sensitive manual tuning and are prone to spectral artifacts. In this paper, we propose a spatial-frequency-aware INR framework that combines an MLP branch with a Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) branch for complementary frequency-oriented modeling. The MLP branch provides a low-frequency-oriented representation of smooth structures, whereas the KAN branch complements localized variations and fine details. To coordinate the two branches, we integrate the discrete wavelet transform (DWT) and inverse discrete wavelet transform (IDWT) into the output fusion stage. The outputs of the two branches are decomposed into wavelet coefficients, and the corresponding coefficients are additively fused before inverse wavelet reconstruction. A wavelet-domain band-separation regularization further penalizes high-frequency responses in the MLP branch and low-frequency responses in the KAN branch, thereby encouraging complementary frequency-oriented behavior. Experiments on 1D signals, 2D images, 3D volumes and signed distance functions, videos, and 4D light-fields demonstrate the applicability of the proposed representation across the evaluated signal modalities. Results demonstrate improved reconstruction fidelity across the evaluated signal modalities.

title: Progressive Style Transfer for Exemplar-based Open-world Sketch Colorization
summary_zh: 本研究提出一种基于示例的开放世界草图着色渐进式风格迁移方法。
summary_en: This study proposes a progressive style transfer method for exemplar-based open-world sketch colorization.
insights: 创新点：提出渐进式风格迁移方法
方法亮点：解决开放世界草图着色问题
关键发现：提高风格迁移的灵活性
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing a progressive style transfer method
Method highlight: Addressing the open-world sketch colorization problem
Key finding: Improving flexibility of style transfer
abstract: Sketch colorization in open-world scenarios presents unique challenges due to diverse, unpaired datasets and the variety in user-generated sketch styles. Traditional exemplar-based methods, which typically rely on dense feature matching and style normalization, struggle to generalize effectively in these conditions, as they require structured paired data and exhibit limited flexibility. We introduce Progressive Style Transfer (PROST), a completely unsupervised framework that addresses these limitations by progressively injecting style features into sketches without rigid content-style alignment. PROST comprises two key modules: Progressive Style Injection (PSI), which transfers style features adaptively across scales, and Progressive Style Enhancement (PSE), which refines style coherence through multi-layer style-adaptive attention. Together, these modules enable flexible style transfer that preserves content fidelity while achieving high stylistic coherence. Our approach also integrates a Dual Cycle-Consistency (DCC) framework to ensure both style and content consistency in generated outputs. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that PROST effectively generalizes to unseen styles, achieving robust performance across varied datasets and setting a new benchmark for open-world sketch colorization. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Vincotto/ProST.

title: Preserving Structural Irreplaceability in Token Pruning through Local Representation Complexity
summary_zh: 本文提出一种通过局部表示复杂性来保留结构不可替代性的视觉token剪枝策略。
summary_en: This paper proposes a token pruning strategy that preserves structural irreplaceability through local representation complexity.
insights: 创新点：提出基于局部表示复杂性的token剪枝策略
方法亮点：解决token冗余问题
关键发现：提高模型压缩性能
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing a token pruning strategy based on local representation complexity
Method highlight: Addressing token redundancy issues
Key finding: Improving model compression performance
abstract: The effectiveness of vision token pruning critically depends on the criterion used to define token redundancy. Existing approaches, which primarily rely on global saliency scores or similarity heuristics, often fail to account for a token's essential contribution to the model's internal representations. This oversight results in retaining visually prominent but redundant tokens or merging semantically distinct features, severely degrading performance under tight compression budgets. To address this, we propose a novel token pruning strategy aligned with representation complexity. We first introduce Local Representation Complexity (LRC), a token-level measure that estimates the intrinsic dimension of each token's embedding. Tokens exhibiting high LRC are considered locally unpredictable and are therefore prioritized for preservation. To ensure selection diversity and mitigate over-concentration in the selected set, we frame the pruning process as a budget allocation problem and introduce a Greedy Selection algorithm with Penalized Diversity to actively suppress redundancy. We evaluate the proposed method across five vision-language model backbones from three model families, including LLaVA-1.5/LLaVA-NeXT, Qwen2.5-VL/Qwen3-VL, and InternVL3, covering a wide range of capacities and tasks. The results demonstrate competitive performance across different backbones, with particularly notable gains at aggressive compression ratios.

title: Dynamic Knowledge-Aware for Streaming View Clustering
summary_zh: 研究流式视图聚类问题，提出DNA框架，缓解灾难性遗忘。实验表明，DNA框架有效提升聚类性能。
summary_en: Investigates the Streaming View Clustering problem, proposes the DNA framework to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Experiments show that the DNA framework effectively improves clustering performance.
insights: 创新点：提出DNA框架解决灾难性遗忘问题
方法亮点：动态知识感知机制有效缓解遗忘
关键发现：DNA框架显著提升聚类性能
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes the DNA framework to address catastrophic forgetting
Method highlight: Dynamic knowledge-aware mechanism effectively mitigates forgetting
Key finding: The DNA framework significantly improves clustering performance
abstract: In real scenarios, multi-view data are often continuously acquired in the form of view streams, giving rise to the task of Streaming View Clustering (SVC). However, most existing methods rely on view-specific knowledge to guide the learning of the current view, while neglecting the shared, view-invariant knowledge structure across views. As a result, the model progressively forgets the commonalities between current and historical views during training, i.e., catastrophic forgetting, which leads to severe fluctuations in clustering performance under different input sequences. To address this issue, we propose a Dynamic kNowledge-Aware (DNA) framework for SVC, which is designed to mitigate the negative impact of catastrophic forgetting effectively. The proposed DNA framework consists of two main stages: the initial learning stage and the continual learning stage. Specifically, during the initial learning stage, we employ knowledge-aware learning to extract prototype knowledge from the first acquired view and construct an initial knowledge base. During the continual learning stage, we leverage knowledge aggregation learning to maximize the consistency between the prototype knowledge of the current view and the historical knowledge, and then fuse them into a new prototype knowledge and update the knowledge base, thereby ensuring the completeness of the learned knowledge. Finally, through structural guidance learning, the updated knowledge base is used to steer the sample distribution of the current view, thereby ensuring distributional consistency across different views. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that DNA consistently and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at https://github.com/hl-yuan/DNA.

title: Degradation-aware Infrared Image Super-Resolution
summary_zh: 研究红外图像超分辨率，提出DIRSR框架，考虑红外退化。实验表明，DIRSR有效改善图像质量。
summary_en: Studies infrared image super-resolution, proposes the DIRSR framework considering infrared degradation. Experiments show that DIRSR effectively improves image quality.
insights: 创新点：DIRSR框架考虑红外退化特性
方法亮点：引入退化感知语义引导
关键发现：DIRSR提升图像稳定性
insights_en: Novelty: DIRSR framework considers infrared degradation characteristics
Method highlight: Introduces degradation-aware semantic guidance
Key finding: DIRSR improves image stability
abstract: Infrared image super-resolution (IISR) is inherently more challenging than its visible-light counterpart due to the presence of structured, infrared-specific degradations, including thermal noise, fixed-pattern noise, and spatially non-uniform blur. These degradations deviate substantially from commonly assumed degradation models and often lead existing methods to produce unstable structures, amplified noise, or hallucinated textures. In this work, we present DIRSR, a degradation-aware framework for infrared image super-resolution that explicitly incorporates infrared degradation perception into the restoration process. The proposed approach characterizes instance-level infrared degradation conditions and leverages degradation-aware semantic guidance to regulate the trade-off between perceptual quality and structural fidelity. In addition, infrared imaging priors are embedded into a physics-informed, region-aware optimization objective to enhance foreground structural consistency while suppressing spurious background details. Extensive experiments on multiple public infrared benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both quantitative performance and visual quality, and further improves downstream infrared detection and segmentation tasks.

title: Vector Map as Language: Toward Unified Remote Sensing Vector Mapping
summary_zh: 研究遥感矢量地图，提出向量地图语言模型，统一映射。实验表明，模型有效处理异构地图元素。
summary_en: Studies remote sensing vector mapping, proposes a vector map language model for unified mapping. Experiments show that the model effectively handles heterogeneous map elements.
insights: 创新点：提出向量地图语言模型
方法亮点：灵活表达异构地图元素
关键发现：模型提升映射准确性
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a vector map language model
Method highlight: Flexibly expresses heterogeneous map elements
Key finding: The model improves mapping accuracy
abstract: Remote sensing vector mapping aims to generate structured maps of geospatial entities, such as buildings, roads, and water bodies, from remote sensing imagery. In practice, vector maps usually contain multiple category layers and heterogeneous entity structures, requiring a unified model for diverse mapping needs. However, existing methods typically represent vector objects as polygons or graphs, making them suitable only for specific categories: polygons poorly capture topological relations, while graphs often blur instance boundaries. We observe that language, as a natural medium for human communication, offers a flexible and expressive representation that can accommodate heterogeneous map elements, including geometry, semantics, and topology. Motivated by this insight, we propose Vector Map as Language (VecLang), a unified paradigm that reformulates multiclass vector mapping as structured text generation. VecLang encodes the common elements of different geospatial entities into a GeoJSON-like vector language, enabling cross-category modeling within a shared textual format. To generate this language reliably, we design a progressive vision-language mapping framework that first localizes vectorization units and then generates structured map elements. We further introduce Hierarchical Vector Language Optimization, which uses reinforcement learning to improve syntax validity, content fidelity, and map executability. We also build VecMap with 46k images and 800K instances, supporting training and evaluation across standard and generalization settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VecLang handles both single-class and multiclass vector mapping while achieving strong cross-dataset and open-vocabulary generalization.

title: EnvGS++: Modeling View-Dependency with Real-Time Environment Gaussians
summary_zh: 研究场景反射重建，提出EnvGS++方法，使用高斯原语。实验表明，EnvGS++有效捕捉反射细节。
summary_en: Studies scene reflection reconstruction, proposes the EnvGS++ method using Gaussian primitives. Experiments show that EnvGS++ effectively captures reflection details.
insights: 创新点：EnvGS++使用高斯原语建模
方法亮点：结合基础高斯原语建模场景外观
关键发现：EnvGS++提升反射细节捕捉
insights_en: Novelty: EnvGS++ uses Gaussian primitives for modeling
Method highlight: Combines base Gaussian primitives to model scene appearance
Key finding: EnvGS++ improves reflection detail capture
abstract: Reconstructing complex reflections in real-world scenes from 2D images is essential for achieving photorealistic novel view synthesis. Existing methods that utilize environment maps to model reflections from distant lighting often struggle with high-frequency reflection details and fail to account for near-field reflections. In this work, we introduce EnvGS++, a novel approach that employs a set of Gaussian primitives as an explicit 3D representation for capturing reflections of environments. EnvGS++ is the journal extension of our preliminary conference work EnvGS [1]. These environment Gaussian primitives are incorporated with base Gaussian primitives to model the appearance of the whole scene. To efficiently render these environment Gaussian primitives, we developed a ray-tracing-based renderer that leverages the GPU's RT core for fast rendering. This allows us to jointly optimize our model for high-quality reconstruction while maintaining real-time rendering speeds. To further boost the rendering speed, we introduce the SnugProxy acceleration strategy for reducing wasted computation in both the rasterization and ray tracing process. Additionally, we propose diffuse regularization to further stabilize and accelerate optimization. Results from multiple real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate that our method produces significantly more detailed reflections, achieving the best rendering quality in real-time novel view synthesis.

title: TRUE: Towards Robust, Unique, and Efficient Model Fingerprint Generation and Verification
summary_zh: 研究模型指纹生成与验证，提出TRUE框架，平衡鲁棒性、唯一性和效率。实验表明，TRUE有效保护模型知识产权。
summary_en: Studies model fingerprint generation and verification, proposes the TRUE framework to balance robustness, uniqueness, and efficiency. Experiments show that TRUE effectively protects model intellectual property.
insights: 创新点：TRUE框架平衡指纹生成三要素
方法亮点：采用对抗样本增强指纹鲁棒性
关键发现：TRUE提升模型安全性
insights_en: Novelty: TRUE framework balances the three elements of fingerprint generation
Method highlight: Adopts adversarial examples to enhance fingerprint robustness
Key finding: TRUE improves model security
abstract: While deep neural networks (DNNs) are being widely adopted, they are also increasingly exposed to model stealing risks, posing significant threats to intellectual property. Model fingerprinting, which utilizes intrinsic characteristics derived from the training process to authenticate models, has been proposed as a potential solution. An ideal fingerprint should satisfy robustness, uniqueness, and efficiency. However, existing methods often struggle to balance these three aspects simultaneously. To address this challenge, we propose TRUE, a twostage fingerprint generation and verification framework. In the fingerprint generation stage, we adopt adversarial examples as the fingerprint type and enhance their robustness through a minmax robust optimization strategy. In the fingerprint verification stage, we assign weights to the adversarial examples using a Boltzmann distribution to reflect their uniqueness, and further employ sampling based on these weights to reduce the number of queries and improve efficiency. Extensive experiments conducted on real-world datasets and across different model architectures demonstrate the superiority of the TRUE framework.

title: HPS-MVC: Hierarchical Pseudo-Supervised Multi-View Clustering
summary_zh: 研究多视图聚类，提出HPS-MVC方法，利用多级伪监督。实验表明，HPS-MVC提升聚类效果。
summary_en: Studies multi-view clustering, proposes the HPS-MVC method using hierarchical pseudo-supervision. Experiments show that HPS-MVC improves clustering performance.
insights: 创新点：HPS-MVC利用多级伪监督信号
方法亮点：构建锚图进行图融合
关键发现：HPS-MVC优化聚类结果
insights_en: Novelty: HPS-MVC leverages hierarchical pseudo-supervision signals
Method highlight: Constructs anchor graphs for optimal graph fusion
Key finding: HPS-MVC optimizes clustering results
abstract: Existing pseudo-supervised multi-view clustering methods typically utilize pseudo-supervision at a single semantic level, which fails to capture the intrinsic structure of complex data and thus restricts clustering performance. We propose Hierarchical Pseudo-Supervised Multi-View Clustering (HPS-MVC), which leverages multi-level semantic pseudo-supervision signals to guide the clustering process. Specifically, hierarchical pseudo-supervision signals are constructed by mining sample neighborhood relations and are then used to aggregate samples at different semantic levels as inputs to an anchor-based multi-view clustering model. A dual-weighting strategy is further introduced to select high-quality anchor graphs for optimal graph fusion. An efficient alternating optimization algorithm is developed to solve the resulting problem. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability of the proposed method.

title: Contextual Chamfer Distance for Point Cloud Restoration
summary_zh: 研究点云恢复，提出CCD方法，从高阶角度建模。实验表明，CCD提升几何保真度。
summary_en: Studies point cloud restoration, proposes the CCD method from a high-order perspective. Experiments show that CCD improves geometric fidelity.
insights: 创新点：CCD从高阶角度建模点云相似性
方法亮点：Patch Density Consistency促进几何完整性
关键发现：CCD提升几何保真度
insights_en: Novelty: CCD models point cloud similarity from a high-order perspective
Method highlight: Patch Density Consistency promotes geometric completeness
Key finding: CCD improves geometric fidelity
abstract: Accurate similarity measurement between point clouds is crucial for 3D geometry restoration. Chamfer Distance (CD) and its variants quantify such similarity in a permutation-invariant manner, yet they emphasize low-order point-wise proximity, leading to clustered distributions and long-range structural distortions that undermine geometric fidelity. This work rethinks point cloud similarity from a high-order standpoint and introduces Contextual Chamfer Distance (CCD), a geometrically consistent formulation that jointly models point-wise proximity, local distribution consistency, and long-range structural consistency. Specifically, Patch Density Consistency (PDC) aligns relative patch densities between predicted and ground-truth points, promoting spatial coverage for geometric completeness, while Anchor Normal Consistency (ANC) models long-range relationships through anchor normals derived from non-degenerate point triplets, improving structural coherence and geometric accuracy. Alongside this formulation, we develop a conditional local coordinate-space stability and convergence analysis and derive sufficient conditions for local linear convergence of the corresponding weighted objective under explicit local assumptions. Extensive experiments on completion, compression, and upsampling across architectures and six datasets demonstrate consistent quantitative and qualitative gains across settings, a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off, and strong generalization.

title: Towards Robust Multi-View Clustering via Early-to-late Manifold Consistency Calibration
summary_zh: 研究多视图聚类，提出Early-to-late Manifold Consistency Calibration方法，解决视图质量不平衡问题。实验表明，方法有效提升聚类鲁棒性。
summary_en: Studies multi-view clustering, proposes the Early-to-late Manifold Consistency Calibration method to address view quality imbalance. Experiments show that the method effectively improves clustering robustness.
insights: 创新点：Early-to-late Manifold Consistency Calibration解决视图质量不平衡
方法亮点：自适应视图特定编码引导学习
关键发现：方法提升聚类鲁棒性
insights_en: Novelty: Early-to-late Manifold Consistency Calibration addresses view quality imbalance
Method highlight: Adaptive view-specific encoding guides learning
Key finding: The method improves clustering robustness
abstract: For multi-view data, structural heterogeneity across views is a common property, with cross-view sparsity variation serving as a typical manifestation. To first account for this sparsity-induced heterogeneity, we develop Adaptive View-specific Encoding, which incorporates the sparsity ratio of each view as prior knowledge for view-aware representation learning and constraint modulation. Based thereon, we further tackle the broader issue of view quality imbalance in multi-view fusion, where low-quality views introduce unreliable structural relations and view-specific constraints further amplify latent discrepancies. To this end, we propose a globallocal manifold-guided fusion mechanism named Early-to-late Manifold Consistency Calibration, which leverages the relatively stable global manifold preserved in early-fused encoded features to modulate robust late-stage fusion of adaptively encoded local features. Specifically, the early-stage global features serve as a structural anchor for assessing the manifold consistency of features of each adaptively encoded local view. The resulting consistency scores are then used to adaptively reweight late-stage global fusion, attenuating structurally unreliable views while reinforcing those aligned with the common manifold. In this manner, latent manifold consistency enables early fusion to calibrate late-stage fusion, thereby establishing a principled connection between adaptive view-specific encoding and cross-view distribution alignment. The full framework, named Manifold Consistency Guided Adaptive Sparse Autoencoder for Multiview Clustering (MASA), is validated on multiple datasets and demonstrates superior effectiveness and robustness across diverse experimental settings. On ALOI-100, MASA further enhances clustering stability, reducing the fluctuation standard deviation over the final rounds from 3.02% to 1.28%.

title: Bridging the Training Gap with Hyperion: A Training-Free Style Transfer Method on Diffusion Transformers
summary_zh: 本文提出Hyperion，一种无训练风格迁移方法，解决MM-DiT中训练适配器与注入式无训练方法间的差距。优化层面引入Adam-in-loop，恢复梯度驱动的耦合效应。
summary_en: This paper proposes Hyperion, a training-free style transfer method for MM-DiT, addressing the gap between trained adapters and injection-based methods. The optimization level introduces Adam-in-loop to recover gradient-driven coupling effects.
insights: 创新点：Hyperion方法填补了MM-DiT中训练适配器与注入式无训练方法间的差距。
方法亮点：引入Adam-in-loop优化，恢复梯度驱动的耦合效应。
关键发现：Hyperion在风格迁移上优于现有无训练方法。
insights_en: Novelty: Hyperion bridges the gap between trained adapters and injection-based methods in MM-DiT.
Method highlight: The introduction of Adam-in-loop optimizes and recovers gradient-driven coupling effects.
Key finding: Hyperion outperforms existing training-free methods in style transfer.
abstract: Training-free style transfer on Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiT) remains challenging due to the persistent gap between trained adapters and injection-based training-free methods. Existing training-free methods typically perform forward feature injection, and thus struggle to reproduce the rich painterly textures achieved by trained adapters, often leading to only faint hue shifts. In this paper, we trace this limitation to the absence of backpropagation-induced spatial coupling and propose Hyperion, a fully training-free style-transfer pipeline for MM-DiT. At the optimization level, the pipeline introduces Adam-in-loop, which iteratively optimizes the diffusion latent at each denoising step with a frozen MM-DiT. This process recovers the gradient-driven coupling effect produced through the self-attention value path, where neighboring tokens receive highly similar updates and form coherent brushstroke textures. At the distribution level, the pipeline introduces Sinkhorn Latent Transport (SLT), a single closed-form optimal-transport step that pre-aligns latent color distributions before Adam optimization, improving the operational efficiency of Adam-in-loop. To further enhance stylization quality, we develop a frequency-domain Sinkhorn loss to sharpen painterly textures and a layout-residual-suppression step to reduce layout interference. The pipeline can also be extended to image-to-image stylization. Extensive experiments on a 39-style × 6-prompt benchmark (234 pairs) demonstrate that Hyperion achieves CSD $= 0.640$ and CLIP-T $= 0.296$, improving CSD by +5.2% over Adam-8 at $2.5\times$ lower forward-pass cost and by +16.6% over Adam-only under an equal compute budget. Notably, Hyperion outperforms four pre-trained style adapters on 19 of 21 diverse style families, achieving a mean CSD of 0.657 versus 0.506 for the strongest baseline.

title: Representation of Directed Acyclic Graphs by Sequences of Instructions for Symbolic Regression
summary_zh: 本文引入ISALSR，将标记DAG映射到结构操作标记的规范字符串，通过1-WL子树哈希算法指导贪婪算法。
summary_en: This paper introduces ISALSR, mapping labeled DAGs to canonical strings over a two-tier alphabet of structural and operation-labeled tokens, guided by a greedy algorithm using 1-WL subtree hashing.
insights: 创新点：ISALSR将DAG映射到规范字符串，提高搜索效率。
方法亮点：使用1-WL子树哈希指导贪婪算法，实现高效映射。
关键发现：规范字符串是标记DAG的完整不变量。
insights_en: Novelty: ISALSR maps DAGs to canonical strings, improving search efficiency.
Method highlight: The use of 1-WL subtree hashing guides the greedy algorithm for efficient mapping.
Key finding: The canonical string is a complete invariant of labeled DAGs.
abstract: Symbolic Regression (SR) aims to discover a closed-form mathematical expression that fits an observed dataset by representing those expressions as Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs). A DAG with k internal nodes admits Θ(k!) equivalent node orderings of the same expression, so structurally identical candidates repeatedly reach the fitness evaluator of the solver model, consuming search budget. We introduce ISALSR (Instruction Set and Language for Symbolic Regression), an encoding that maps every labeled DAG to a canonical string over a two-tier alphabet of structural and operation-labeled tokens. Canonical strings are reached via a greedy algorithm guided by 1-Weisfeiler-Leman (1-WL) subtree hashing. We prove that the canonical string is a complete labeled-DAG invariant under a reachability condition: two expressions share their string if and only if their DAGs are isomorphic. ISALSR integrates at the evaluation boundary and needs no change to the host search algorithm. It has been validated on a systematic enumerator (UDFS) and an evolutionary search (Bingo) over a 70-problem suite assembled from nine published benchmarks, against both the host solvers' native representation and a naive hash of a fixed-order DAG serialization. Canonicalization eliminates a mean of 38.1% of evaluations on UDFS and 43.7% on Bingo, on every one of the 70 problems under both hosts. A paired test across problems puts its reduction factor above that of the naive hash at a Cohen's d of 2.54 and 7.05, both at p < 10-12. Canonicalization consumes 0.04% of run time on UDFS and 16.1% on Bingo. Deduplication is therefore close to free where a fitness evaluation costs orders of magnitude more than a canonical string, and expensive where the two are comparable. ISALSR is the first instruction-based graph encoding to carry operation labels, edge direction and a non-commutative operator, and because the canonical form is itself a string, it also gives sequence models a target that is invariant to node renumbering. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/MarioPasc/IsalSR.

title: 2D Gaussian Splatting for Semantic Segmentation via Discrete-to-Continuous Representation toward Boundary-Preserving Feature Upsampling
summary_zh: 本文提出GSSeg，将离散特征空间重构为连续高斯场，实现边界保持特征上采样。
summary_en: This paper presents GSSeg, reformulating the discrete feature space as continuous Gaussian fields for boundary-preserving feature upsampling in semantic segmentation.
insights: 创新点：GSSeg将离散特征空间重构为连续高斯场。
方法亮点：实现边界保持特征上采样。
关键发现：GSSeg在语义分割中优于传统方法。
insights_en: Novelty: GSSeg reformulates the discrete feature space as continuous Gaussian fields.
Method highlight: Achieves boundary-preserving feature upsampling.
Key finding: GSSeg outperforms traditional methods in semantic segmentation.
abstract: High-quality semantic segmentation requires not only rich semantic understanding but also precise delineation of object boundaries. While prevailing methods rely on discrete feature representations that often lead to boundary misalignment, jagged contours, and blurry edges along complex contours, we present GSSeg, a novel semantic segmentation paradigm based on Gaussian Splatting that has been successfully applied to 3D scene reconstruction. Specifically, GSSeg reformulates the discrete feature space as continuous Gaussian fields, thereby rendering spatial continuity modeling to produce high-quality segmentation results. However, directly adapting 2DGS to existing pipelines suffers from the structural granularity loss in low-resolution features and the inherent low-pass limitations of Gaussian rendering. To address the insufficient structural granularity available for discrete-to-continuous transformation, we propose the cross-layer neighborhood interaction scheme utilizing alternating global scanning, which establishes cross-scale contextual cues to enhance adaptive Gaussian kernel generation. Additionally, addressing the inherent low-pass limitations of Gaussian rendering, we introduce spatial uncertainty-aware resampling driven by resolution bias estimation, which selectively compensates for high-frequency details attenuated during Gaussian rendering. Furthermore, we introduce an effective Gaussian kernel initialization strategy that approximates Gaussian radial basis function interpolation, ensuring model training stability. Comprehensive experiments on standard benchmarks, especially high-resolution matting-level dataset MaSS13K, demonstrate that GSSeg achieves state-of-the-art performance.

title: Kernel Adaptive Deformable Convolution for Remote Sensing Object Detection
summary_zh: 本文提出KAD-Conv方法，利用可变形空间卷积自适应调整采样位置，解决RSOD中几何变化建模问题。
summary_en: This paper proposes the KAD-Conv method, using deformable spatial convolution to adaptively adjust sampling locations, addressing the geometric variation modeling challenge in RSOD.
insights: 创新点：KAD-Conv方法自适应调整采样位置。
方法亮点：解决RSOD中几何变化建模问题。
关键发现：KAD-Conv在RSOD中表现优异。
insights_en: Novelty: The KAD-Conv method adaptively adjusts sampling locations.
Method highlight: Solves the geometric variation modeling problem in RSOD.
Key finding: KAD-Conv performs exceptionally well in RSOD.
abstract: Modeling geometric variations, particularly the extreme fluctuations in scale and shape, stands as a persistent challenge in computer vision, which is significantly exacerbated in remote sensing object detection (RSOD). Existing methods are often constrained by the fixed geometric topology of standard convolutions or the insufficient representation power of linear feature aggregation, making it difficult to strike an ideal balance between adaptability and computational efficiency. To address these challenges, we propose a novel scale- and shape-adaptive method named Kernel Adaptive Deformable Convolution (KAD-Conv). Specifically, KAD-Conv employs a specialized Deformable Spatial Convolution (DSC) at its core to adaptively adjust sampling locations, while reformulating the mask generation process to fully leverage the mask's potential for discriminative feature modulation. In KAD-Conv, we further introduce a Scale-aware Kernel Adaptive mechanism, which enables the dynamic adjustment of sampling scales to effectively capture object representations across extreme scale variations without increasing kernel size. With KAD-Conv, we develop a novel object detection network based on Multi-task Guided Learning (MGL), called KAD-CNet. Extensive experiments conducted on widely used remote sensing benchmark datasets, including DOTA-v1.0, DIOR, and NWPU VHR-10, along with validation on natural scenes exhibiting extreme geometric variations, have validated the effectiveness of the proposed KAD-CNet. Moreover, comprehensive comparisons against various YOLO-series models further underscore the practical value and efficiency of the proposed approach.

title: Generative Point Cloud Registration With Match-ControlNet
summary_zh: 本文提出Generative Point Cloud Registration，结合2D生成模型和3D匹配任务，提高注册性能。
summary_en: This paper proposes Generative Point Cloud Registration, combining 2D generative models with 3D matching tasks to enhance registration performance.
insights: 创新点：Generative Point Cloud Registration结合2D生成模型和3D匹配任务。
方法亮点：生成图像对实现几何-颜色特征融合。
关键发现：Match-ControlNet确保高质量匹配。
insights_en: Novelty: Generative Point Cloud Registration combines 2D generative models with 3D matching tasks.
Method highlight: The generated image pair achieves geometry-color feature fusion.
Key finding: Match-ControlNet ensures high-quality matching.
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel 3D registration paradigm, Generative Point Cloud Registration, which bridges advanced 2D generative models with 3D matching tasks to enhance registration performance. Our key idea is to generate cross-view consistent image pairs that are well-aligned with the source and target point clouds, enabling geometry-color feature fusion to facilitate robust matching. To ensure high-quality matching, the generated image pair should feature both 2D-3D geometric consistency and cross-view texture consistency. To this end, we introduce DepthMatch-ControlNet and LiDARMatch-ControlNet, two matching-specific, controllable 2D generative models. Specifically, for depth camera-based 3D registration with point clouds derived from the depth maps, DepthMatch-ControlNet leverages the depth-conditioned generation capabilities of ControlNet to synthesize perspective-view RGB images that are geometrically consistent with depth maps, ensuring accurate 2D-3D alignment. Additionally, by incorporating a coupled conditional denoising scheme and coupled prompt guidance, it further promotes cross-view feature interaction, guiding texture consistency generation. To address LiDAR-based 3D registration with point clouds captured by LiDAR sensors, LiDARMatch-ControlNet extends this framework by conditioning on paired equirectangular range maps projected from 360$^\circ$ LiDAR point clouds, generating corresponding panoramic RGB images. Our generative 3D registration paradigm is general and can be seamlessly integrated into a wide range of existing registration methods to improve their performance. Extensive experiments on the 3DMatch and ScanNet datasets (for depth-camera settings), as well as the Dur360BEV dataset (for LiDAR settings), demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

title: Image Quality Assessment for Machine-oriented Communication
summary_zh: 本文建立机器导向通信系统图像质量评估框架，包括源级生成编解码器和信道级编码解码策略。
summary_en: This paper establishes a visual quality assessment framework for machine-oriented communication systems, including a source-level generative codec and channel-level encoding/decoding strategies.
insights: 创新点：建立机器导向通信系统图像质量评估框架。
方法亮点：源级生成编解码器与文本跨模态生成。
关键发现：信道编码解码策略在不同物理环境下有效。
insights_en: Novelty: Establishes a visual quality assessment framework for machine-oriented communication systems.
Method highlight: Source-level generative codec with cross-modal generation between images and text.
Key finding: Channel encoding/decoding strategies are effective in different physical environments.
abstract: The rapid development of Multimoal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has driven the evolution of communication paradigms, making the transmission of visual information in extremely low-bandwidth possible. However, as it is oriented toward computer vision tasks rather than humans, there is no widely accepted metric for its evaluation. To address this issue, we conduct a comprehensive visual quality assessment of machine oriented communication systems. Specifically, we (1) at the source level: a generative codec framework is established, with a MLLM communication pipeline through cross-modal generation between images and text. (2) at the channel level: images are transmitted using channel encoding/decoding strategies in different physical environments, and construct a dataset with 12k pairs of reference/distorted images. (3) at the sink level: 50 computer vision models are implemented to conduct 600k inferences on 5 downstream tasks, to characterize the differences between refer ence/distorted image pairs. (4) at the evaluation level: benchmark 18 cutting-edge Image Quality Assessment (IQA) methods, and develop a novel Mixture-of-Experts metric, termed CFA-MoE, to serve as a strong baseline for this task. Experimental results show that the current IQA algorithms cannot accurately evaluate machine-oriented distortions, highlighting the importance and challenge of this task. It is expected this dataset and baseline to facilitate future IQA algorithms and promote the communication paradigms from human to machine preference. Code will be available at: https://github.com/aiben-ch/MoQAD.

From Perception to Simulation: Unveiling and Empowering Mental Spatial Dynamics in MLLMs
summary_zh: 研究揭示多模态大型语言模型中的空间推理能力。引入MentalGrid基准，评估模型在动态空间模拟中的表现。
summary_en: This study reveals spatial reasoning capabilities in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Introduces the MentalGrid benchmark to evaluate model performance in dynamic spatial simulation.
insights: 创新点：引入MentalGrid基准评估空间推理
方法亮点：发现现有模型在空间模拟中的不足
关键发现：模型在简单模拟场景中表现受限
insights_en: Novelty: Introduces the MentalGrid benchmark to evaluate spatial reasoning
Method highlight: Found deficiencies in existing models' spatial simulation capabilities
Key finding: Models are constrained in simple simulation scenarios
abstract: Spatial reasoning is a fundamental component of world understanding for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While existing research has advanced the perception of spatial relations in static scenes, the domain of dynamic spatial simulation remains relatively unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce MentalGrid, a benchmark focused on spatial reasoning tasks that require models to simulate evolving spatial states without intermediate visual feedback. Extensive evaluation on our benchmark reveals a significant deficiency in the spatial simulation capabilities of existing models. Specifically, we find that performance is constrained by perceptual limitations in simple simulation scenarios and hindered by inadequate multi-step reasoning as complexity increases. To address these challenges, we propose a three-stage curriculum learning framework utilizing 16k specialized spatial reasoning samples. This approach yields SpatialWalker, which achieves a 33.8% average improvement over its base model, surpassing proprietary models like Gemini-3-Flash in spatial simulation. Furthermore, SpatialWalker demonstrates robust generalization, maintaining a 4.9% average gain on out-of-domain benchmarks, demonstrating the pivotal role of spatial simulation as a fundamental building block for broader spatial intelligence.
