When AUC Meets Generative Reconstruction: A Unified Principle for Balanced Visual Representation Learning
summary_zh: 研究提出了一种统一的学习范式，将生成重建重新定义为判别性排名问题。
summary_en: The study introduces a unified representation-learning paradigm that reformulates generative reconstruction as a discriminative ranking problem.
insights: 创新点：提出统一的学习范式解决优化冲突
方法亮点：将生成重建作为判别性排名问题
关键发现：解决梯度干扰问题
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed a unified learning paradigm to resolve optimization conflicts
Method highlight: Reformulated generative reconstruction as a discriminative ranking problem
Key finding: Resolved gradient interference issues
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) require visual encoders that extract fine-grained visual features while constructing semantically disentangled and discriminative representations. Conventional methodologies encounter a fundamental trade-off: contrastive learning enhances inter-class discrimination by suppressing intra-class variability, whereas generative reconstruction emphasizes perceptual fidelity but lacks explicit comparative supervision. The naive aggregation of these objectives via composite loss functions often induces optimization conflicts and instability due to gradient interference within the shared latent space. To resolve this, we introduce a unified representation-learning paradigm that reformulates generative reconstruction as a discriminative ranking problem within the generative output manifold. Our approach maintains perceptual reconstruction as a supervisory signal and integrates a ranking-based discriminative constraint by systematically ordering matched and mismatched reconstruction outputs. This formulation embeds discriminative information seamlessly into the generative process, alleviating the risk of loss competition. Specifically, we propose AUC Generative Reconstruction (AUCGR), which optimizes the area under the ROC curve (AUC) by ensuring higher scores for matched pairs than for mismatched pairs, and Partial AUC Generative Reconstruction (pAUCGR), which addresses supervision bias by focusing on mismatched comparisons within reliable feature subspaces. The proposed objectives are designed to be plug-and-play, requiring no architectural modifications to existing generative reconstruction frameworks. Theoretical analysis establishes rigorous connections to AUC/pAUC optimization and provides generalization guarantees. Extensive experiments across diverse CLIP architectures, more than 30 visual benchmarks, generative backbones, and MLLMs consistently validate that our method advances both discriminative accuracy and fine-grained perceptual representation, establishing a new benchmark for visual representation learning.

title: A Neuro-symbolic Framework under Statistical Relational Learning
summary_zh: 研究提出了一种基于统计关系学习的神经符号框架，以构建可解释和泛化的智能系统。
summary_en: The study proposes a neuro-symbolic framework based on statistical relational learning for building interpretable and generalizable intelligent systems.
insights: 创新点：提出神经符号框架结合神经学习和符号推理
方法亮点：统一建模神经网络和符号概念
关键发现：增强神经预测和符号推理的交互
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed a neuro-symbolic framework combining neural and symbolic reasoning
Method highlight: Unified modeling of neural and symbolic concepts
Key finding: Enhanced interaction between neural prediction and symbolic reasoning
abstract: Neuro-symbolic systems aim to combine neural learning with symbolic reasoning for building interpretable and generalizable intelligent systems. While recent studies have explored different strategies for neuro-symbolic integration, existing approaches remain limited by (i) the absence of unified learning mechanisms between continuous neural representations and discrete symbolic concepts, (ii) weak interaction between neural prediction and symbolic reasoning, and (iii) restricted reuse of learned concepts for unseen reasoning scenarios. To address these issues, we propose NSF-SRL, a general neuro-symbolic framework based on statistical relational learning. NSF-SRL jointly models neural predictions, latent predicates and first-order logic rules within a unified probabilistic framework. For concept learning, NSF-SRL introduces a neuralized variational inference mechanism that learns predicate-level representations from neural representations and enables efficient neuro-symbolic interaction through variational expectation-maximization optimization. For concept manipulation, NSF-SRL allows learned concepts to be reused and composed with logic rules for interpretable explanation and compositional reasoning. Extensive experiments on digit image addition, zero-shot image classification and visual relationship detection, together with comprehensive analyses, demonstrate the effectiveness, generalization and scalability of NSF-SRL.

title: Human–AI Divergence in Ego-Centric Action Recognition Under Spatial and Spatiotemporal Manipulations
summary_zh: 研究比较了人类和AI在自我中心动作识别上的差异，特别是在空间和时间操作下。
summary_en: The study compares the divergence between humans and AI in egocentric action recognition under spatial and spatiotemporal manipulations.
insights: 创新点：比较了人类和AI在动作识别上的性能差异
方法亮点：使用人类定义的最小识别区域进行实验
关键发现：人类在复杂条件下表现优于AI
insights_en: Novelty: Compared the performance divergence between humans and AI in action recognition
Method highlight: Used human-defined minimal identifiable recognition crops for experiments
Key finding: Humans outperform AI in challenging conditions
abstract: Abstract Humans consistently outperform state-of-the-art AI models in action recognition, particularly in challenging real-world conditions involving low resolution, occlusion, and visual clutter.e those utilised by humans Understanding the sources of this performance gap is essential for developing more robust and human-aligned models. In this paper, we present a large-scale human AI comparative study of egocentric action recognition using human-defined Minimal Identifiable Recognition Crops (MIRCs), defined as the smallest spatial or spatiotemporal regions sufficient for reliable human recognition. We used our previously introduced, Epic-ReduAct, a systematically spatially reduced and temporally scrambled dataset derived from 36 EPIC-KITCHENS videos, spanning multiple spatial reduction levels and temporal conditions. Recognition performance is evaluated using over 3,000 human participants, Side4Video, and Qwen 3.5 9B models. Our analysis combines quantitative metrics, Average Reduction Rate and Recognition Gap, with qualitative analyses of spatial (high-, mid-, and low-level visual features) and spatiotemporal factors, including a categorisation of actions into Low Temporal Actions (LTA) and High Temporal Actions (HTA). Results show that human performance exhibits sharp declines when transitioning from MIRCs to sub-MIRCs, reflecting a strong reliance on sparse, semantically critical cues such as hand object interactions. In contrast, the model degrades more gradually and often relies on contextual and mid- to low-level features, sometimes even exhibiting increased confidence under spatial reduction. Temporally, humans remain robust to scrambling when key spatial cues are preserved, whereas the model often shows insensitivity to temporal disruption, revealing class-dependent temporal sensitivities. Overall, our findings demonstrate that strong benchmark performance can obscure fundamental human AI misalignment and highlight limitations in current spatial and spatiotemporal representations, suggesting concrete directions for more efficient and human-aligned action recognition systems.

title: GRAIL: Granularity Adaptive Representation for Class-Incremental Learning with Granular-Ball
Invertible Gamut Mapping
summary_zh: 研究聚焦于开发基于深度学习的色彩映射方法，以实现宽色域和窄色域之间的双向转换。
summary_en: The study focuses on developing deep learning-based approaches for gamut mapping to achieve bidirectional conversion between wide gamut and small gamut.
insights: 创新点：提出可逆框架进行色彩映射
方法亮点：提高色彩映射的保真度和感知质量
关键发现：解决色彩映射中的色相偏移和伪影问题
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed an invertible framework for gamut mapping
Method highlight: Improved fidelity and perceptual quality of gamut mapping
Key finding: Resolved hue shifts and artifacts in gamut mapping
abstract: Gamut mapping is a crucial component of the image signal processing (ISP) pipeline and color conversion between devices. Improper gamut mapping can introduce noticeable hue shifts and artifacts, resulting in poor visual quality. Although recent studies have significantly improved the fidelity of gamut extension through learning-based models and efficient metadata encoding schemes, the quality of gamut reduction and the intrinsic relationship between gamut reduction and extension have been largely overlooked. In this paper, we focus on developing deep learning-based approaches for gamut mapping that produce images with high color fidelity and perceptual quality for bidirectional conversion between wide gamut and small gamut. We propose an invertible framework that performs both gamut reduction and gamut extension within a single model. In the forward pass, the input wide-gamut image is decomposed into a clipped component and a residual component, which are jointly transformed into a small-gamut image and a latent variable. In the reverse pass, the small-gamut image and a Gaussian latent variable are used to reconstruct the wide-gamut image. To ensure that gamut reduction preserves hue and perceptual color similarity to the wide-gamut image, we introduce a self-supervised hue loss. We conduct experiments on three different gamut mapping scenarios: ProPhoto RGB to sRGB, BT.2020 to sRGB, and sRGB to a smaller "Toy" gamut. The proposed method outperforms previous metadata-free approaches in both color fidelity and perceptual quality across the evaluated gamut mapping scenarios.

title: TAETrack++: Trajectory Age Extension and Motion Refinement for Robust Multi-Object Tracking
summary_zh: 本文提出TAETrack++方法，优化轨迹寿命，提升多目标跟踪性能。通过IoU约束和位置感知，延长轨迹寿命，减少错误匹配。结合轨迹丢失时间，增强跟踪稳定性。
summary_en: This paper proposes TAETrack++ to optimize trajectory lifespan and enhance multi-object tracking performance. It extends trajectory lifespans with IoU constraints and position awareness, reducing erroneous matches, and combines track loss duration for improved stability.
insights: 创新点：提出轨迹寿命优化方法
方法亮点：结合IoU约束和位置感知
关键发现：提升多目标跟踪性能
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a trajectory lifespan optimization method
Method highlight: Combines IoU constraints and position awareness
Key finding: Enhances multi-object tracking performance
abstract: Multi-object tracking (MOT) is a vital task in computer vision, involving the continuous tracking and stable identification (ID) of multiple objects across video sequences. Existing methods often focus heavily on identity matching during association, neglecting the quality of trajectories, which affects object tracking performance. This article proposes a trajectory-age optimization approach for MOT that effectively improves its performance. First, we proposed TAE and TG to adaptively extend trajectory lifespans through IoU constraints and position awareness, allowing long-lost objects to be re-associated with their original trajectories instead of being initialized as new tracks, while suppressing erroneous matches. Second, by incorporating the track loss duration, our method enhances the observation-centric re-update mechanism and an adaptive Kalman filter with a dynamic noise scale, thereby reducing ID switches. Finally, our method combines Gaussian process-based interpolation with wavelet-thresholding denoising, leveraging the optimization of global smoothing and local denoising to improve trajectory smoothness and authenticity. Extensive experiments on the MOT17, MOT20, and DanceTrack standard datasets demonstrate that our method is competitive with the current state-of-the-art trackers and offers more robust ID maintenance across various challenging tracking scenarios.

title: Task Interference Mitigation via Confidence-Stratified Classifier Calibration for Prompt-based Continual Learning
summary_zh: 本文针对基于提示的持续学习中的任务干扰问题，提出按置信度分层分类器校准方法。将样本分为易感、耐药和恢复性三类，揭示任务干扰的根源。
summary_en: This paper addresses task interference in prompt-based continual learning by proposing a confidence-stratified classifier calibration method. It categorizes samples into susceptible, refractory, and resilient types to reveal the root of task interference.
insights: 创新点：提出置信度分层分类器校准
方法亮点：样本分层处理
关键发现：揭示任务干扰根源
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes confidence-stratified classifier calibration
Method highlight: Sample stratification processing
Key finding: Reveals the root of task interference
abstract: Prompt-based continual learning is a promising direction that effectively leverages the capabilities of pre-trained models. These methods typically learn task-specific prompts and predict task identity to select the prompt during inference. However, task interference caused by prompt misselection significantly constrains their performance. Although several studies have attempted to mitigate this issue, they treat all samples equally, without specifically addressing the samples that are primarily affected by prompt misselection. In this paper, we stratify samples into three distinct categories according to their different responses to prompt misselection, including susceptible samples, refractory samples, and resilient samples. This stratification reveals that misselection-induced interference primarily manifests in susceptible samples, as only their classification correctness is influenced by prompt misselection, while other samples remain unaffected. This realization drives us to design a novel prompt-based approach called Confidence-Stratified Classifier Calibration (CoSC), which harnesses the complementary roles of all categories to safeguard susceptible samples. Specifically, we apply targeted optimization based on the unique properties of each category to cooperatively calibrate classifiers of both the prompt instruction part and the prompt selector, thereby protecting susceptible samples from dual perspectives. Extensive experiments show that CoSC achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmarks in class-incremental learning.

title: Pedestrian Pre-Collision Pose Generation from Eyewitness Descriptions Without Visual Evidence
summary_zh: 本文提出从目击者描述生成行人预碰撞姿态的方法，解决视觉数据缺乏的问题。构建PVCP2数据集，提出PPSG框架，生成高风险场景下的行人姿态。
summary_en: This paper proposes a method for generating pedestrian pre-collision poses from eyewitness descriptions, addressing the issue of lacking visual data. It constructs the PVCP2 dataset and proposes the PPSG framework for generating pedestrian poses in high-risk scenarios.
insights: 创新点：从目击者描述生成姿态
方法亮点：构建PVCP2数据集
关键发现：生成高风险场景下的姿态
insights_en: Novelty: Generates poses from eyewitness descriptions
Method highlight: Constructs the PVCP2 dataset
Key finding: Generates poses in high-risk scenarios
abstract: The pedestrian pre-collision pose is a key factor influencing the severity of pedestrian-vehicle injuries. Current methods for acquiring human poses still rely heavily on visual data, such as images or videos. However, traffic accidents are highly unpredictable and often lack sufficient visual evidence, making it difficult to reconstruct pedestrian pre-collision poses and limiting the accuracy of injury assessments. Moreover, general models trained on daily activity datasets perform poorly in high risk scenarios with unusual poses and show limited robustness under occlusion, blur, and data scarcity. To address these challenges, we construct the Pedestrian-Vehicle pre-Collision Pose Text (PVCP2) dataset and propose the Pedestrian Pre-collision poSe Generation (PPSG) framework, which generates pedestrian pre-collision poses from eyewitness oriented structured descriptions without visual records. The PVCP2 dataset employs VLM-assisted annotation and template-based semantic refinement to produce 10K+ fine-grained text-pose pairs spanning diverse pre-collision scenarios. The PPSG framework is built upon a conditional variational autoencoder architecture, where an LLM-driven text encoder and a pose prior encoder jointly learn cross-modal latent representations. During inference, the model takes structured eyewitness descriptions as the sole input to generate multiple SMPL-based 3D pre-collision poses, enabling effective user selection and expert analysis. Experiments demonstrate superior performance over existing methods in both text-pose alignment and pose accuracy, offering a scalable and interpretable solution for downstream traffic safety applications in the absence of visual evidence. Code and data are available at https://github.com/wmj142326/PPSG.

title: Fast and Compressed ADA-UNet: Refractive-Index Reconstruction with Latent-Domain Low-Rank Compression
summary_zh: 本文提出快速压缩的ADA-UNet，用于衍射光学断层扫描的折射率重建。采用低秩压缩，降低计算成本，实现非迭代重建。
summary_en: This paper proposes a fast and compressed ADA-UNet for refractive-index reconstruction in optical diffraction tomography. It employs low-rank compression to reduce computational cost and achieve non-iterative reconstruction.
insights: 创新点：提出快速压缩的ADA-UNet
方法亮点：低秩压缩降低成本
关键发现：非迭代重建
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a fast and compressed ADA-UNet
Method highlight: Low-rank compression reduces cost
Key finding: Non-iterative reconstruction
abstract: Optical diffraction tomography (ODT) provides label-free three-dimensional refractive-index (RI) maps, but conventional reconstructions are highly sensitive to speckle noise and severely under-sampled illumination angles. We propose ADA-UNet, a compact two-stage framework in which (i) a modality-specific autoencoder learns a compact representation of stitched diffraction inputs, and (ii) a latent-domain ResUNet maps these interferometric latent codes to RI latent codes for non-iterative reconstruction. For compactness, the interferometry-to-RI mapping is expressed in Dirac form, but the network itself is implemented entirely with standard convolutional operators on GPU hardware. To reduce computational cost without changing the reconstruction objective, low-rank factorization is applied specifically to the ADA-aligned latent mapper. The resulting compressed model, ADA-UNetc, reduces the parameter count from 12.5M to 6.0M (a 52% reduction) while maintaining nearly unchanged reconstruction quality, with SSIM changing from 0.943 to 0.940 and NRMSE from 0.051 to 0.052. Across all evaluated ODT, cross-modal image-synthesis, and adaptation baselines, the proposed model achieves the best overall fidelity and a measured per-volume inference time of 187 s, compared with 221-840 s for the baselines. Experiments on synthetic and real 2-D/3-D data further demonstrate robustness under evaluation-time noise perturbations and sparse-angle acquisition, highlighting the potential of ADA-UNet for efficient and reliable quantitative phase imaging.

title: Bogong moths navigate with a light-dependent geomagnetic inclination compass
summary_zh: 本文发现Bogong蛾利用光依赖的磁倾角罗盘导航。在无星夜空下，仅利用地磁场导航，且对磁场方向变化敏感。
summary_en: This paper finds that Bogong moths navigate using a light-dependent geomagnetic inclination compass. They navigate using the geomagnetic field alone in starless skies and are sensitive to magnetic field direction changes.
insights: 创新点：发现光依赖的磁倾角罗盘
方法亮点：仅利用地磁场导航
关键发现：对磁场方向敏感
insights_en: Novelty: Discovers a light-dependent geomagnetic inclination compass
Method highlight: Navigates using the geomagnetic field alone
Key finding: Sensitive to magnetic field direction changes
abstract: Abstract Bogong moths ( Agrotis infusa ) migrate biannually up to 1,000 km between their breeding areas and geographically restricted aestivation sites in the Australian Alps 1,2 . These moths navigate towards their distant goal using the stars as a compass 3 but navigate correctly even when the stars are obscured by clouds 3 , suggesting that their magnetic sense 4 probably harnesses the Earth’s magnetic field as a compass. However, the nature of this compass, and of the magnetic sense underlying it, remains unknown. Here we show that Bogong moths, tethered in a flight arena under a full-spectrum randomized starry night sky, navigate in their inherited migratory direction using the geomagnetic field alone. If the geomagnetic field is turned by 180°, or if inclination is inverted, moths fly in the opposite direction. If polarity is inverted, moths fail to turn. Furthermore, if violet–blue light (380 nm < λ < 500 nm) is removed from the illumination spectrum, or if tethered moths are exposed to weak broadband radiofrequency fields (150 kHz to 60 MHz), magnetic orientation is abolished. Our results indicate that Bogong moths use the geomagnetic field as an inclination compass for long-distance navigation at night and possess a light-dependent radical-pair-based magnetic sense 5 .

title: As El Niño builds, studies of extreme marine heatwaves must start now
summary_zh: 本文强调研究极端海洋热浪的重要性。随着厄尔尼诺现象发展，需跟踪海洋变暖，为渔业和依赖其的社区提供策略。
summary_en: This paper emphasizes the importance of studying extreme marine heatwaves. As El Niño builds, it is crucial to track ocean warming to provide strategies for fisheries and communities that depend on them.

方法亮点：跟踪海洋变暖
关键发现：为渔业和社区提供策略
insights_en: Novelty: Emphasizes the importance of studying extreme marine heatwaves
Method highlight: Tracks ocean warming
Key finding: Provides strategies for fisheries and communities
abstract: Researchers must track warming oceans and use the knowledge gained to inform strategies for sustaining fisheries and communities that depend on them.

title: Quantum physics can prove where you are
Flat-band-induced integer doping and phase transition in monolayer graphene
summary_zh: 本文报道在单层石墨烯中通过平带诱导实现整数掺杂和相变。通过栅极调控，实现晶格对称性变化，揭示动态异质结构。
summary_en: This paper reports integer doping and phase transition in monolayer graphene induced by flat-band. Gate tuning achieves lattice symmetry changes, revealing a dynamic heterostructure.
insights: 创新点：平带诱导整数掺杂和相变
方法亮点：栅极调控晶格对称性
关键发现：揭示动态异质结构
insights_en: Novelty: Flat-band-induced integer doping and phase transition
Method highlight: Gate tuning lattice symmetry
Key finding: Reveals a dynamic heterostructure
abstract: Abstract van der Waals heterostructures are stabilized by a delicate balance between van der Waals, elastic and Coulomb energies 1–4 . Because the interfaces are not covalently bonded, the constituent crystals can slide, rotate and reconstruct, resulting in several possible competing structural phases 2,5,6 . However, controlled tuning of this balance, and hence dynamical control over the stacking, has yet to be achieved. Here we report a dynamical heterostructure in which monolayer graphene is doubly aligned to bulk hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) and monolayer hexagonal boron nitride (mhBN) on either side. In such a system, a global structural phase transition, manifested as a change of crystalline symmetry observed by scanning tunnelling microscopy, could be induced by gating, magnetic field or temperature. This structural transition is accompanied by an exotic electronic transition: the doping of graphene switches between discrete levels, corresponding to an exact integer number of electrons or holes per moiré plaquette. We attribute this integer doping to charge trapping in localized, strain-induced pseudo-Landau levels (flat bands in reciprocal space 7–12 ), produced by moiré reconstruction (strongly enhanced by the mhBN). Electrical control of coupled structural and electronic phase transitions provides a route to engineering strain-induced flat bands and strain–Coulomb correlations in van der Waals heterostructures.

title: Tropical land-use intensification restructures biodiversity
summary_zh: 本文评估热带土地利用强度对生物多样性的影响。尽管单一栽培损失多样，但未发现社区同质化趋势。
summary_en: This paper assesses the impact of tropical land-use intensification on biodiversity. Despite losses in monocultures, no evidence of community homogenization was found.
insights: 创新点：评估热带土地利用强度对生物多样性的影响
方法亮点：生态系统评估
关键发现：单一栽培未导致社区同质化
insights_en: Novelty: Assessing the impact of tropical land-use intensification on biodiversity
Method highlight: Ecosystem-wide assessment
Key finding: Monocultures do not lead to community homogenization
abstract: Abstract Tropical land-use intensification threatens global biodiversity, yet most assessments of tropical agricultural landscapes focus on local-scale biodiversity, overlooking how land use restructures biodiversity across space and multiple taxa. Here we provide an ecosystem-wide assessment of 24 taxonomic groups across all domains of life—encompassing 40,049 species—along a land-use intensification gradient from lowland forests to intensively managed smallholder cash-crop monocultures in Indonesian landscapes. Despite widespread losses of landscape and local multidiversity 1 in monocultures (approximately 78% and 50%, respectively), we found no evidence for consistent community homogenization with land-use intensification. Instead, monocultures exhibit a systematic shift from turnover to nestedness for aboveground taxa. Such patterns of differentiation may mask trajectories towards biotic homogenization via early stages of assemblage simplification. Biotic differentiation has the potential to partly mitigate biodiversity losses by positively affecting γ-diversity. This opens management options, including the conservation of existing remnants of traditional agriculture and the implementation of sustainable management practices 2–4 . Our results demonstrate that tropical land-use intensification restructures biodiversity not only through species loss, but also via a pervasive reorganization of community composition across trophic levels. Conserving tropical biodiversity, therefore, requires a multi-taxon, landscape-scale perspective that explicitly integrates agricultural land uses with the protection of natural and semi-natural habitats to reconcile agricultural production and conservation.

Machine learning-driven regulation of the four-electron LiOH pathway in lithium–oxygen batteries with prolonged cycling
summary_zh: 利用机器学习和密度泛函理论，识别出Ni-Co双原子催化剂在多电子转移中的优势配置，实现锂-氧电池的长期循环。
summary_en: An artificial intelligence-integrated framework using interpretable machine learning and density functional theory identifies Ni-Co dual-atom catalysts as a superior configuration for multi-electron transfer in lithium-oxygen batteries with prolonged cycling.
insights: 创新点：机器学习辅助锂-氧电池催化剂选择
方法亮点：利用密度泛函理论分析
关键发现：Ni-Co催化剂优化多电子转移
insights_en: Novelty: Machine learning aids in lithium-oxygen battery catalyst selection
Method highlight: Density functional theory analysis
Key finding: Ni-Co catalyst optimizes multi-electron transfer
abstract: Abstract The practical deployment of high-energy-density lithium–oxygen batteries is fundamentally restricted by sluggish oxygen redox kinetics and the instability of discharge intermediates. Here, we report an artificial intelligence-integrated framework leveraging interpretable machine learning and density functional theory to navigate a vast chemical space of thousands of active sites. This approach identifies Ni-Co dual-atom catalysts as a better configuration among the selected elements for orchestrating multi-electron transfer. Theoretical analysis reveals that synergistic electronic coupling between the dual-sites fundamentally reconfigures the d -band center, thereby lowering the thermodynamic barriers for oxygen redox. Moreover, the catalysts enable precise regulation of the reaction pathway, inducing a controllable transition from the conventional two-electron pathway to a four-electron pathway. This shift yields a discharge capacity of ~60,000 mAh g −1 . Beyond its role as a positive electrode catalyst, this architecture functions as a multifunctional interfacial protective layer that stabilizes the lithium metal negative electrode by suppressing dendrite growth. Consequently, the lithium–oxygen system achieves stable lifespan of 2075 cycles under the four-electron pathway with reduced voltage decay. This work establishes a data-guided strategy for the rational design of atomic-scale architecture via artificial intelligence, unlocking the potential of multi-electron oxygen chemistry for lithium–oxygen batteries.

title: Structure-guided design of a dual-antigen mRNA vaccine conferring broad protection against Henipaviruses
FLAME: Flow Guidance and Adaptive Frequency Fusion for All-in-One Mamba-Enhanced Video Restoration
summary_zh: 研究提出FLAME框架，结合显式对齐和隐式建模进行视频恢复。FLAME通过互补时空序列和希尔伯特序列Mamba块进行高效建模。
summary_en: The study proposes the FLAME framework, combining explicit alignment with implicit modeling for video restoration. FLAME efficiently models using complementary Space-Time Sequence and Hilbert-Sequence Mamba blocks.
insights: 创新点：FLAME视频恢复框架
方法亮点：融合显式对齐和隐式建模
关键发现：时空序列Mamba块的应用
insights_en: Novelty: FLAME video restoration framework
Method highlight: Fusion of explicit alignment with implicit modeling
Key finding: Application of spatiotemporal sequence Mamba blocks
abstract: All-in-One video restoration under adverse weather conditions (e.g., rain, snow, haze) remains challenging, as existing methods either rely on explicit optical flow alignment that becomes unreliable under heavy degradations, or employ implicit sequence modeling that lacks fine-grained temporal correspondence. We propose FLAME, a unified FLow guidance and Adaptive frequency fusion for all-in-one Mamba-Enhanced video restoration framework that synergistically combines explicit alignment with implicit modeling through three core components: (i) Dual-Path Mamba Modeling with complementary Space-Time Sequence Mamba and Hilbert-Sequence Mamba blocks for efficient spatiotemporal modeling with linear-complexity Mamba scanning; (ii) Flow-guided Lightweight Attention featuring degradation-aware flow estimation with triple quality assessment and temporal-spatial attention deformable fusion; (iii) Adaptive Frequency Residual Fusion employing learnable frequency decomposition and cross-channel attention for degradation-specific spectral enhancement. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance: 35.50 dB PSNR on VRDS (+3.46 dB over RainMamba), 40.17 dB on LWDDS (+2.96 dB over RainMamba), 31.04 dB on W3 multiweather benchmark (+0.59 dB over AIM-VR), and 29.00 dB on RainSynAll100 rain-haze mixture (+1.33 dB over BasicVSR++), validating the effectiveness of explicit-implicit synergy for diverse weather degradation restoration.

title: TimeSeek: Multi-Task and Multi-Domain Pretraining for Generalized Time Series Analytics
summary_zh: 本文提出TimeSeek模型，自适应建模多域时间序列模式。解决现有TSFMs参数堆叠和任务特定性不足问题。实验表明模型在多任务上表现优异。
summary_en: This paper proposes the TimeSeek model, which adaptively models patterns from multi-domain time series data. It addresses the issues of parameter stacking and insufficient task specificity in existing TSFMs. Experiments show the model performs well on multi-task scenarios.
insights: 创新点：自适应建模多域时间序列模式
方法亮点：解决参数堆叠和任务特定性不足问题
关键发现：模型在多任务上表现优异
insights_en: Novelty: Adaptive modeling of multi-domain time series patterns
Method highlight: Solving the issues of parameter stacking and insufficient task specificity
Key finding: The model performs well on multi-task scenarios
abstract: Time series analytics has been widely applied across various domains. While existing time series foundation models (TSFMs) have demonstrated promising results, they still face two major challenges: 1) Most TSFMs mainly rely on stacking Transformer layers to increase parameter size, lacking the ability to adaptively model complex time series patterns from multi-domain data. 2) Current TSFMs are primarily pre-trained for specific tasks, e.g., forecasting or anomaly detection, and a few models support multiple tasks, but they fail to fully leverage task specificity and commonality, resulting in suboptimal performance. To address these challenges, we propose TimeSeek, a novel generalized time series analytics model that adaptively models time series patterns from multi-domain data and unifies multiple tasks in pre-training. Conceptually, TimeSeek is guided by selective information sharing under domain and task heterogeneity. From the perspective of multi-domain data, we propose a Multi-Domain Feature Extractor that adaptively captures temporal dependencies and channel correlations based on domain-specific characteristics, including progressive multi-scale modeling and adaptive slot channel modeling. From the perspective of the diversity of tasks, we propose multi-task collaborative training, which leverages task specificity and task commonality through task customization and cross-task training, effectively unifying multiple tasks in pre-training and better adapting to diverse downstream scenarios. After pre-training on large-scale time series data, TimeSeek achieves state-of-the-art performance in forecasting, anomaly detection, and classification tasks across both few-shot learning and zero-shot situations, together with favorable inference efficiency.

title: Bridging the Thermal Gap: Data-Model Collaborative Transfer for Infrared Perception
summary_zh: 本文提出数据-模型协同迁移框架，解决红外视觉感知中数据与模型转移的依赖性问题。通过任务响应生成器和形成引导表示实现。
summary_en: This paper proposes a data-model collaborative transfer framework to address the interdependence issue in infrared visual perception. It achieves this through a task-responsive generator and a formation-guided representation.
insights: 创新点：数据-模型协同迁移框架
方法亮点：任务响应生成器和形成引导表示
关键发现：解决数据与模型转移的依赖性问题
insights_en: Novelty: Data-model collaborative transfer framework
Method highlight: Task-responsive generator and formation-guided representation
Key finding: Solving the interdependence issue in data and model transfer
abstract: Infrared visual perception fundamentally differs from visible-domain vision due to its distinct thermal imaging mechanism and varying imaging conditions. Existing methods typically decouple data construction from model transfer, overlooking their interdependence: model accuracy and robustness depend critically on the coverage and composition of training observations, while effective model transfer requires explicit modeling of infrared-specific imaging characteristics. To address this issue, we propose a data-model collaborative transfer framework for infrared visual perception. At the data level, a task-responsive generator learns weights over a feasible infrared imaging-variation space to construct informative training observations. At the model level, a formation-guided representation module derives complementary radiance-structure and response-detail descriptors from infrared observations. We further design a thermal-aware adapter that uses these descriptors to modulate intermediate representations and produce lightweight residual corrections for model transfer. A single-loop training strategy coordinates data generation, representation learning, and adapter optimization without expensive nested optimization. Extensive experiments on image enhancement, depth estimation, small-target detection, and semantic segmentation demonstrate consistent performance improvements across multiple foundation-model backbones with a small trainable parameter budget.

title: Real-World Spectral Compressive Imaging by Learning a Physics-Informed Forward Model
summary_zh: 本文提出可学习物理信息前向模型，解决CASSI系统模拟与现实的差距。通过结合物理结构和可学习代理网络实现。
summary_en: This paper proposes a learnable physics-informed forward model to bridge the simulation-to-reality gap in CASSI systems. It achieves this by incorporating the physical structure into a learnable proxy network.
insights: 创新点：可学习物理信息前向模型
方法亮点：结合物理结构和可学习代理网络
关键发现：解决模拟与现实的差距
insights_en: Novelty: Learnable physics-informed forward model
Method highlight: Incorporating physical structure into a learnable proxy network
Key finding: Bridging the simulation-to-reality gap
abstract: Coded aperture snapshot spectral imaging (CASSI) enables snapshot acquisition of hyperspectral image (HSI) by compressing a three-dimensional spectral data into a single two-dimensional measurement. While recent learning-based reconstruction methods achieve impressive performance on simulated datasets, their performance often degrades significantly on real CASSI systems, revealing a simulation-to-reality gap. This gap arises from a mismatch between the complex real imaging process and the reconstruction mappings learned from idealized simulated data. To bridge this simulation-to-reality gap, we propose a learnable physics-informed forward model (LPFM) that incorporates the physical structure of CASSI into a learnable proxy network to model the complex real imaging process. To train the LPFM, we construct the first real-world spectral compressive imaging (rSCI) dataset. The rSCI dataset contains 219 pairs of static HSI-CASSI images across diverse indoor and outdoor scenes, as well as additional dynamic CASSI videos. Leveraging rSCI and LPFM, we establish the first real-world benchmark for CASSI reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that incorporating data generated by LPFM effectively reduces the simulation-to-reality gap and consistently improves reconstruction performance across various state-of-the-art methods.

title: Knowledge-enhanced Incomplete Multi-view Clustering on Relational Knowledge
summary_zh: 本文提出知识增强的锚点IMVC框架，解决传统策略在知识利用不足的问题。通过锚点和锚图的知识增强机制实现。
summary_en: This paper proposes a knowledge-enhanced anchor-based IMVC framework to address the insufficient knowledge utilization in traditional strategies. It achieves this through knowledge enhancement mechanisms for anchors and anchor graphs.
insights: 创新点：知识增强的锚点IMVC框架
方法亮点：锚点和锚图的知识增强机制
关键发现：解决知识利用不足问题
insights_en: Novelty: Knowledge-enhanced anchor-based IMVC framework
Method highlight: Knowledge enhancement mechanisms for anchors and anchor graphs
Key finding: Solving the issue of insufficient knowledge utilization
abstract: Incomplete multi-view clustering (IMVC) methods have drawn increasingly attention these years, as their better potential to the complex real-world scenario. The key of the models in such tasks is how to perform high-quality imputation. Traditional intra-view and inter-view imputation strategies rely mainly on observed features. Such strategies may introduce semantic noise and biased estimations, making it difficult to recover the true semantics of missing views. Meanwhile, they are hard to directly apply to relational knowledge MVC, as fail to utilize the knowledge sufficiently. To this end, we propose a simple yet effective knowledge-enhanced anchor-based IMVC framework with two specific knowledge enhancement mechanisms, i.e., one for anchors, and the other for anchor graph. With the structural knowledge enhancement, the model can be gifted with better expressive ability and get good results. Extensive experiments compared with 10 models have proven the promising capacity of our method from 5 aspects, i.e., superiority, stability, sensitivity, complexity, and visualization. Notably, as the first work on IMVC on relational knowledge, 45 incomplete multi-view datasets are constructed with missing ratios ranging from 10% to 90%, which also facilitate the future research.

Boosting reinforcement learning for critical node detection with multi-topology training strategies
summary_zh: 提出结合强化学习和图神经网络的多拓扑训练策略，提高关键节点检测。
summary_en: Propose a machine learning framework combining reinforcement learning with an attention-based graph neural network for critical node detection.
insights: 创新点：结合强化学习和图神经网络
方法亮点：多拓扑训练策略
关键发现：模型适应和泛化能力强
insights_en: Novelty: Combining reinforcement learning with graph neural networks
Method highlight: Multi-topology training strategies
Key finding: Strong adaptation and generalization capabilities of the model
abstract: Identifying pivotal components in complex networks—such as key intersections in transportation systems, influential actors in social networks, or keystone species in ecosystems—is essential for improving the resilience and mitigating catastrophic failures of these systems. However, existing methods for critical node detection are typically tailored to specific network types and objectives, limiting their generalizability. To overcome this limitation, we propose a machine learning framework that combines reinforcement learning with an attention-based graph neural network. By leveraging multi-topology training, our model learns to adapt and generalize across diverse network structures and objective functions. Experiments on real-world and synthetic networks uncover distinct topological features that are important for identifying critical nodes. Notably, our method applied to personalized gene networks, prioritizes genes that are significantly enriched for cataloged cancer drivers. This work provides a robust critical node detection model with a comprehensive multi-topology training approach, suitable for a broader range of real-world applications. Critical node detection helps identify network elements whose removal most disrupts connectivity. Here, the authors develop a reinforcement-learning approach that trains on diverse graph topologies to improve generalization to both synthetic and real networks.

title: Structurally guided wavefront neural encoder for broad-range generalizable 3D holography
summary_zh: 提出结构引导波前神经网络编码器，结合衍射物理与神经网络，实现尺度归一化的衍射描述。通过直接推理，模型能跨传播距离和可见波长泛化。
summary_en: A structurally guided wavefront neural encoder is proposed, integrating diffraction physics with neural networks to achieve a scale-normalized description of diffraction. The model can generalize across propagation distances and visible wavelengths by direct inference.
insights: 创新点：结构引导波前神经网络编码器
方法亮点：尺度归一化的衍射描述
关键发现：模型跨传播距离和波长泛化
insights_en: Novelty: Structurally guided wavefront neural encoder
Method highlight: Scale-normalized description of diffraction
Key finding: Model generalization across propagation distances and wavelengths
abstract: Deep learning has advanced computer-generated holography, but learned models remain coupled to fixed wavelengths and distances, limiting generalization. Here we present the structurally guided wavefront neural encoder (SGWN-Encoder), which integrates diffraction physics with neural networks and employs a structural propagation strategy that analytically strips the parameter-sensitive global phase. This reveals a scale-normalized description of diffraction, letting the network learn transferable light-field evolution rules and generalize across propagation distances and visible wavelengths by direct inference. A dataset-free paradigm built on statistically diverse random fields teaches the model the structural mapping from complex amplitude to phase-only holograms instead of external image distributions. Without fine-tuning, a single SGWN-Encoder maintains a distance-averaged RGB PSNR of 31.9 dB and SSIM of 0.91 over the primary 2–200 mm range, retaining reconstruction up to 500 mm. Numerical and optical experiments on full-color 3D scenes establish a physically grounded route toward adaptive holographic displays.

Retrieval-Augmented Task-Aware Transformer for Video Procedure Learning
summary_zh: 研究提出一种检索增强的任务感知Transformer模型，用于视频程序学习。该模型解决跨路径任务泛化不足和时空定位不准确的问题。
summary_en: This study proposes a retrieval-augmented task-aware Transformer model for video procedure learning, addressing challenges of insufficient cross-route task generalization and insufficient temporal-visual grounding.
insights: 创新点：提出检索增强的任务感知Transformer模型
方法亮点：解决跨路径任务泛化不足问题
关键发现：提高时空定位准确性
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a retrieval-augmented task-aware Transformer model
Method highlight: Solves the problem of insufficient cross-route task generalization
Key finding: Improves temporal-visual grounding accuracy
abstract: Procedure learning aims to jointly recognize and localize key steps from instructional videos given an ordered step list. The goal is to predict precise temporal spans for each step. Existing methods typically treat this as a sequence-to-sequence alignment task. However, as the provided step lists lack deeper task-level knowledge, we observe that these models often struggle with two challenges: (1) Missing cross-route task generalization, where models overfit to single annotated pattern and fail to capture the diverse yet semantically valid routes of the same task; and (2) Insufficient temporal-visual grounding, where the absence of concrete timing and appearance priors in the provided step lists leads to boundary drift and step error when predicting on individual videos. To address these challenges, we propose the Task-Aware Transformer (TAT), a unified framework that integrates task-level priors into the alignment process. TAT consists of two complementary components: (i) Task-Aware Structured Memory Construction, which aggregates semantic, temporal, and visual knowledge from multiple execution routes into a structured memory. To ensure the memory remains faithful to supervision, we introduce a Memory Constraint Loss that jointly encodes semantic consistency and temporal order. (ii) Retrieval-Augmented Video-Step Alignment, which retrieves a knowledge-enriched route from the memory to serve as contextual guidance, injecting fine-grained priors into the frame-to-step alignment. We further design two alignment strategies, a lightweight cross-modal decoder and a Vision-Language Model association, to balance efficiency and generalization. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks (YouCookII, COIN, CrossTask, and ProceL) demonstrate that TAT consistently outperforms existing methods, particularly in generalizing to novel procedural compositions, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

title: Disentanglement-Guided Multi-Teacher Relational Distillation for Federated Class-Incremental Facial Expression Recognition
summary_zh: 研究提出一种解耦引导的多教师关系蒸馏方法，用于联邦增量面部表情识别。该方法解决灾难性遗忘和客户端异质干扰问题。
summary_en: This study proposes a disentanglement-guided multi-teacher relational distillation method for federated class-incremental facial expression recognition, addressing problems of catastrophic forgetting and heterogeneous disturbances across clients.
insights: 创新点：提出解耦引导的多教师关系蒸馏方法
方法亮点：解决灾难性遗忘问题
关键发现：提高联邦增量面部表情识别性能
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a disentanglement-guided multi-teacher relational distillation method
Method highlight: Solves the problem of catastrophic forgetting
Key finding: Improves performance of federated class-incremental facial expression recognition
abstract: Conventional facial expression recognition (FER) methods often train the model on large-scale centralized expression data. However, expression data are often distributed across heterogeneous devices and incrementally collected in practice. In this paper, we study a little-studied yet important task named federated class-incremental FER (FCI-FER), which aims to incrementally identify unseen compound expressions with the model initially trained on easily accessible basic expressions under the federated learning settings. To address the unique problems of catastrophic forgetting and heterogeneous disturbances across clients in FCI-FER, we propose a disentanglement-guided multi-teacher relational distillation (DMT-RD) method which follows a novel "distillation and disentanglement" paradigm. For local training, we design a multi-teacher hypergraph relational distillation (MTD) module to capture semantic relations between expressions and learn expression features. Meanwhile, we develop a disturbance encoding (DE) module to learn client-specific disturbance information. By minimizing the mutual information (MI) loss between the outputs of the MTD and DE modules, we can achieve feature disentanglement and reduce the negative influence of specific disturbances on local training. For global training, we introduce a multi-teacher learning strategy by clustering historical clients to comprehensively capture client diversity across communication rounds. Our method can effectively preserve old knowledge while learning new compound expressions under federated settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method against several state-of-the-art federated class-incremental learning methods on benchmark datasets.

title: Learning Physical Priors Embedded in Underwater Imaging and Light Attenuation for Self-Supervised Underwater Depth Estimation
summary_zh: 研究提出UIEMono模型，将水下成像和光衰减的物理特性转化为深度估计线索。该模型通过重建输入图像提高水下深度估计的准确性。
summary_en: This study proposes the UIEMono model, which transforms the physical characteristics of underwater imaging and light attenuation into depth estimation cues, improving the accuracy of underwater depth estimation by reconstructing the input image.
insights: 创新点：提出UIEMono模型进行水下深度估计
方法亮点：将物理特性转化为深度估计线索
关键发现：提高水下深度估计的准确性
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes the UIEMono model for underwater depth estimation
Method highlight: Transforms physical characteristics into depth estimation cues
Key finding: Improves accuracy of underwater depth estimation
abstract: Depth information is crucial for the perception and navigation of underwater robots. While existing methods incorporate underwater physical priors into self-supervised monocular depth estimation to mitigate the impact of image degradation, challenges such as depth misestimation in background regions, loss of edge details, and limited generalization capabilities remain to be addressed. In this paper, we propose UIEMono, which transforms the physical characteristics of underwater imaging and light propagation into depth estimation cues and incorporates them into the self-supervised learning pipeline. Specifically, multiple networks predict the latent components of the underwater image formation model to reconstruct the input image. This reconstruction process, combined with the geometric projection relationships between adjacent frames, assists the network in learning to infer scene depth. During training, we adopt two distinct estimation strategies for the forward attenuation coefficient: in the early stages, it is predicted as a global constant within each image to ensure training stability; in the later stages, a two-term exponential model is utilized to model its dependency on depth, thereby achieving joint optimization. The constraint relationship between the latent components of homologous images is used to provide additional supervision. We leverage the inherent relationship between depth and light attenuation to provide additional cues for guiding network learning. Furthermore, we weight the reprojection loss based on the intensity differences between channels to avoid the negative impact of photometric errors in background regions. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance and can generalize to a wider range of underwater scenarios.

Self-Supervised Uncalibrated Multi-View Video Anonymization in the Operating Room
summary_zh: 研究手术室视频匿名化，提出无需标注和校准的多视角匿名化框架。
summary_en: This study focuses on OR video anonymization, proposing a multi-view anonymization framework without annotation or calibration.
insights: 创新点：无需标注和校准的多视角匿名化框架
方法亮点：基于自监督领域自适应的单视角检测
关键发现：提高了手术室视频匿名化的效率和准确性
insights_en: Novelty: A multi-view anonymization framework without annotation or calibration
Method highlight: Self-supervised domain adaptation based on single-view detection
Key finding: Improved efficiency and accuracy of OR video anonymization
abstract: Privacy preservation is a prerequisite for using video data in Operating Room (OR) research. Effective anonymization relies on the exhaustive localization of every individual; even a single missed detection necessitates extensive manual correction. However, existing approaches face two critical scalability bottlenecks: (1) they usually require manual annotations at each new clinical site for high accuracy; (2) multi-view approaches typically require camera calibration whenever cameras are repositioned. To address these problems, we propose a self-supervised multi-view video anonymization framework based on whole-body person detection and pose estimation, without manual annotations or camera calibration. Our core strategy is to conduct self-supervised domain adaptation of a single-view detector by "retrieving" false negatives using temporal and multi-view context. We first apply an off-the-shelf wholebody detector with a low-score threshold to gather candidate detections. Then, we retrieve low-score false negatives that are consistent with high-score detections via tracking and self-supervised, uncalibrated multi-view association. The recovered detections serve as pseudo-labels to iteratively fine-tune the detector. Finally, we apply whole-body pose estimation on each detected person, and fine-tune the pose model using its own high-score predictions. Experiments on the simulated 4D-OR dataset and our real-surgery dataset achieve 99% and 97% recall, respectively. We further train a real-time whole-body detector using the generated pseudo-labels, achieving comparable performance and highlighting our method's practical applicability. Code will be available at https://github.com/CAMMA-public/ OR_anonymization.

title: Task-Agnostic Incremental Vision-Language Object Detection via Prompt Augmentation and Distribution-Aware Fusion
summary_zh: 本文研究无监督增量视觉语言目标检测，提出TADA框架解决跨任务干扰。实验表明，TADA在无监督场景下表现优异。
summary_en: This paper studies unsupervised incremental vision-language object detection, proposes the TADA framework to address cross-task interference. Experiments show that TADA performs excellently in the unsupervised setting.
insights: 创新点：无监督增量视觉语言目标检测
方法亮点：TADA框架解决跨任务干扰
关键发现：TADA在无监督场景下表现优异
insights_en: Novelty: Unsupervised incremental vision-language object detection
Method highlight: TADA framework resolves cross-task interference
Key finding: TADA excels in the unsupervised setting
abstract: Incremental Vision-Language Object Detection (IVLOD) empowers pre-trained open-vocabulary detectors to continuously learn new visual concepts from sequential tasks without forgetting foundational knowledge. However, existing methods predominantly rely on oracle task identities during inference, severely limiting their open-world practicality. In this paper, we formalize Task-Agnostic IVLOD (TA-IVLOD), a more realistic setting where such priors are unavailable, requiring the model to simultaneously recognize classes from all learned tasks. This unconstrained setting exposes severe performance degradation due to cross-task semantic interference and parameter conflicts. To tackle these challenges, we propose TADA, a novel modular framework. Specifically, TADA introduces Stochastic Prompt Augmentation to mitigate semantic interference via training-time noise injection, and Test-Time Distribution-Aware Fusion to dynamically weight class-specific LoRA experts, effectively resolving parameter conflicts. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms baselines in standard IVLOD and yields substantial improvements in the rigorous TA-IVLOD setting on the ODinW-13 benchmark, while effectively preserving zero-shot generalization on the MS COCO dataset. The code is available at https://github.com/yonghanjiang/TADA.

title: CrownFusion: 3D Dental Crown Generation Using Geometry Images and Latent Diffusion
summary_zh: 本文提出CrownFusion，利用几何图像和潜在扩散模型生成3D牙冠设计。实验表明，该方法能生成符合个体病例的牙冠。
summary_en: This paper introduces CrownFusion, a method for generating 3D dental crown designs using geometry images and latent diffusion models. Experiments show that this method can generate crowns tailored to individual patient cases.
insights: 创新点：利用几何图像和潜在扩散模型生成牙冠
方法亮点：生成符合个体病例的牙冠
关键发现：CrownFusion在牙冠生成中表现良好
insights_en: Novelty: Generating crowns using geometry images and latent diffusion models
Method highlight: Generating crowns tailored to individual patient cases
Key finding: CrownFusion performs well in crown generation
abstract: We introduce CrownFusion, a latent diffusion model to generate 3D dental crown designs from geometry images, a 2D-grid encoding of surface coordinates. Departing from traditional approaches that use point clouds, our"CrownImage"representation not only unlocks the full power of image-based generative architectures, but also preserves fine geometric detail by operating at far higher spatial resolutions than point clouds to alleviate smoothing artifacts in the 3D generation. Conditioned on jointly learned embeddings of the surrounding dentition, our probabilistic diffusion model produces anatomically plausible crowns with morphological variations tailored to individual patient cases. To accommodate multiple valid designs, we propose an occlusal fit metric based on proximity to the antagonist teeth. We evaluate our method through quantitative experiments and qualitative studies involving expert testimonials. We also release the FDI 16 Crown Dataset, comprising 11,513 annotated intra-oral scans, to support future research in dental CAD.
